GSAK:${GLS_STRUCTDESC}板块平均自重(不包括铝框):
   玻璃的体积密度为:  ${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}(kN/m^3)          (JGJ102-2003  5.3.1) ${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,0):+
   t \: 玻璃厚度 ${GLS_to}mm }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,1):+
   t1\: 外层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_to}mm
   t2\: 内层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_ti}mm }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,2):+
   t1\: 外层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_to}mm
   t2\: 内层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_ti}mm }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,3):+
   t1\: 外层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_to}mm
   t2\: 中间层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_tmg}mm
   t3\: 内层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_ti}mm }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,4):+
   t1\: 外层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_to}mm
   t2\: 第二层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_tmg}mm
   t3\: 第三层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_ti}mm
   t4\: 第四层玻璃厚度 ${GLS_GLS4}mm } ${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,0):+
   GSAK=${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×t/1000
       =${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×${GLS_to}/1000 }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,1):+
   GSAK=${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(t1 + t2)/1000
       =${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(${GLS_to} + ${GLS_ti})/1000 }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,2):+
   GSAK=${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(t1 + t2)/1000
       =${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(${GLS_to} + ${GLS_ti})/1000 }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,3):+
   GSAK=${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(t1 + t2 + t3)/1000
       =${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(${GLS_to} + ${GLS_tmg} + ${GLS_ti})/1000 }${IsEqual(GLS_STRUCT,4):+
   GSAK=${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(t1 + t2 + t3 + t4)/1000
       =${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×(${GLS_to} + ${GLS_tmg} + ${GLS_ti} + ${GLS_GLS4})/1000 }
       =${GLS_GAK}kN/m^2
   玻璃板块的重力设计值为
   G = ${γGfm}×${GLS_GAK}×${GLS_AREA}
     = ${Mul(γGfm,Mul(GLS_GAK,GLS_AREA))}kN

   GSAK=${GetM(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×t/1000

校核依据: df≤dflim=${GLS_awl}/${GLS_DFNum}×1000=${GLS_dflim}mm                
   D: 玻璃刚度(N·mm)
   ν: 玻璃泊松比: ${GetVr(GLS_NAMEO)}
   E: 玻璃弹性模量 : ${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}N/mm^2
   ${GLS_ti:*t\: 玻璃板块厚度\: ${GLS_to}mm}${GLS_ti:+te\: ${GLS_STRUCTDESC}的等效厚度
   te=${IsLarge(GLS_tm,3.0):+0.95×}(t1^3+t2^3)^(1/3)
     =${IsLarge(GLS_tm,3.0):+0.95×}(${GLS_to}^3+${GLS_ti}^3)^(1/3)
     =${GLS_te}mm}
   D=E×t${GLS_ti:+e}^3/12/(1-ν^2)
    =${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×${GLS_te}^3/12/(1-${νw}^2)
    =${GLS_Dw}N·mm
   qk: 玻璃所受组合荷载标准值:${GLS_COMPK}kN/m^2
   μ: 挠度系数,按边长比a/b查     表6.1.3得: ${GetSDr(GLS_Hw,GLS_Bw)}
   参数θ计算: 
   θ=qk×a^4/E/t${GLS_ti:+e}^4        (JGJ102-2003  6.1.2-3) 
    =${GLS_COMPK}×${GLS_awl}^4/${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}/${IFValue(GLS_ti,GLS_te,GLS_to)}^4×10^9 
    =${GLS_θwe} 
   η: 折减系数,根据参数θ查表6.1.2-2  得η = ${GetNg(GLS_θwe)} 
   df: 玻璃组合荷载标准值作用下挠度最大值
   df=μ×qk×a^4×η/D         (JGJ102-2003  6.1.3-2)
     =${GetSDr(GLS_Hw,GLS_Bw)}×${GLS_COMPK}×${GLS_awl}^4×${GetNg(GLS_θwe)}/(${GLS_Dw})×10^9 
     =${GLS_dfw}mm 
   ${GLS_DISP}mm${GetLess(GLS_DWLESS)}dflim=${GLS_dflim}mm 
   玻璃的挠度${GLS_DWLESS:*不}满足

校核依据: df≤dflim=${GLS_awl}/${GLS_DFNum}×1000=${GLS_dflim}mm                
   D: 玻璃刚度(N·mm)
   ν: 玻璃泊松比: ${GetVr(GLS_NAMEO)}
   ${GLS_ti:*t\: 玻璃板块厚度\: ${GLS_to}mm}${GLS_ti:+te\: ${GLS_STRUCTDESC}的等效厚度
   te=${IsLarge(GLS_tm,3.0):+0.95×}(t1^3+t2^3)^(1/3)
     =${IsLarge(GLS_tm,3.0):+0.95×}(${GLS_to}^3+${GLS_ti}^3)^(1/3)
     =${GLS_te}mm}
   D=E×t${GLS_ti:+e}^3/12/(1-ν^2)
    =${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×${GLS_te}^3/12/(1-${νw}^2)
    =${GLS_Dw}N·mm
   qk: 玻璃所受组合荷载标准值:${GLS_COMPK}kN/m^2
   μ: 挠度系数,按边长比a/b查     表6.1.3得: ${GetSDr(GLS_Hw,GLS_Bw)}
   参数θ计算: 
   θ=qk×a^4/E/t${GLS_ti:+e}^4        (JGJ102-2003  6.1.2-3) 
    =${GLS_COMPK}×${GLS_awl}^4/${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}/${IFValue(GLS_ti,GLS_te,GLS_to)}^4×10^9 
    =${GLS_θwe} 
   η: 折减系数,根据参数θ查表6.1.2-2  得η = ${GetNg(GLS_θwe)} 
   df: 玻璃组合荷载标准值作用下挠度最大值
   df=μ×qk×a^4×η/D         (JGJ102-2003  6.1.3-2)
     =${GetSDr(GLS_Hw,GLS_Bw)}×${GLS_COMPK}×${GLS_awl}^4×${GetNg(GLS_θwe)}/(${GLS_Dw})×10^9 
     =${GLS_dfw}mm 
   ${GLS_DISP}mm${GetLess(GLS_DWLESS)}dflim=${GLS_dflim}mm 
   玻璃的挠度${GLS_DWLESS:*不}满足

(1)组合荷载作用下结构胶粘结宽度的计算:
   Cs1: 组合荷载作用下结构胶粘结宽度 (mm)
   W: 组合荷载设计值: ${GLUE_COMP}kN/m^2
   a:  矩形分格短边长度: ${GLUE_SHORTSIDE}m
   f1: 结构胶的短期强度允许值:${fglu1}N/mm^2
       按5.6.2条规定采用
   Cs1=W×a/2/f1     
      =${GLUE_COMP}×${GLUE_SHORTSIDE}/2/${fglu1}
      =${GLUE_cs1}mm    取${Ceil(GLUE_cs1)}mm
${GLUE_CALCCS2:+(2)板块面内荷载效应胶缝宽度的计算\:
   Cs2\: 自重效应胶缝宽度 (mm)
   B\: 幕墙分格宽\: ${GLUE_Bw}m
   H\: 幕墙分格高\: ${GLUE_Hw}m
   GA\:玻璃板块面内荷载\:${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}
   f2\: 结构胶的长期强度允许值\: ${fglu2}N/mm^2
       按5.6.2条规定采用   ${IsNLarge(GLUE_YKTYPE,1):+
   Cs2=H×B×GA/(H+B)/2000/f2    (JGJ102-2003  5.6.3-3)
      =${GLUE_Hw}×${GLUE_Bw}×${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}/(${GLUE_Hw}+${GLUE_Bw})/2000/${fglu2}×1000
      =${GLUE_cs2}mm    取${Ceil(GLUE_cs2)}mm   }${IsNLarge(GLUE_YKTYPE,1):*
   Cs2=H×B×GA/a/2000/f2    (JGJ102-2003  5.6.3-3)
      =${GLUE_Hw}×${GLUE_Bw}×${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}/${GLUE_SUPSIDE}/2000/${fglu2}×1000 
      =${GLUE_cs2}mm    取${Ceil(GLUE_cs2)}mm   }
(3)}${GLUE_CALCCS2:*(2)}结构硅酮密封胶的最小计算宽度: ${GLUE_cscal}mm

(1)组合荷载作用下结构胶粘结宽度的计算:
   Cs1: 组合荷载作用下结构胶粘结宽度 (mm)
   W: 组合荷载设计值: ${GLUE_COMP}kN/m^2
   a:  矩形分格短边长度: ${GLUE_SHORTSIDE}m
   f1: 结构胶的短期强度允许值:${fglu1}N/mm^2
       按5.6.2条规定采用
   Cs1=W×a/2/f1     
      =${GLUE_COMP}×${GLUE_SHORTSIDE}/2/${fglu1}
      =${GLUE_cs1}mm    取${Ceil(GLUE_cs1)}mm
${GLUE_CALCCS2:+(2)面内荷载效应胶缝宽度的计算\:
   Cs2\: 面内荷载效应胶缝宽度 (mm)
   B\: 幕墙分格宽\: ${GLUE_Bw}m
   H\: 幕墙分格高\: ${GLUE_Hw}m
   GA\:玻璃板块面内荷载\:${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}
   f2\: 结构胶的长期强度允许值\: ${fglu2}N/mm^2
       按5.6.2条规定采用   ${IsNLarge(GLUE_YKTYPE,1):+
   Cs2=H×B×GA/(H+B)/2000/f2    (JGJ102-2003  5.6.3-3)
      =${GLUE_Hw}×${GLUE_Bw}×${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}/(${GLUE_Hw}+${GLUE_Bw})/2000/${fglu2}×1000
      =${GLUE_cs2}mm    取${Ceil(GLUE_cs2)}mm   }${IsNLarge(GLUE_YKTYPE,1):*
   Cs2=H×B×GA/a/2000/f2    (JGJ102-2003  5.6.3-3)
      =${GLUE_Hw}×${GLUE_Bw}×${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}/${GLUE_SUPSIDE}/2000/${fglu2}×1000 
      =${GLUE_cs2}mm    取${Ceil(GLUE_cs2)}mm   }
(3)}${GLUE_CALCCS2:*(2)}结构硅酮密封胶的最小计算宽度: ${GLUE_cscal}mm

(1)温度变化效应胶缝厚度的计算:
   Ts: 温度变化效应结构胶的粘结厚度: mm
   δ1: 结构硅酮密封胶的温差变位承受能力: ${GLUE_RADTMP}
   △Ｔ: 年温差: ${GLOB_TEMPDIFF}℃
   Us: 玻璃板块在年温差作用下玻璃与铝型材相对位移量: mm
   铝型材线膨胀系数: al=2.35×10^-5
   玻璃线膨胀系数: aw=1×10^-5
  Us=b×△Ｔ×(2.35-1)/100
    =${GLUE_LONGSIDE}×${GLOB_TEMPDIFF}×(2.35-1)/100
    =${GLUE_ustemp}mm
  Ts=Us/(δ1×(2+δ1))^0.5                     (JGJ102-2003  5.6.5)
    =${GLUE_ustemp}/(${GLUE_RADTMP}×(2+${GLUE_RADTMP}))^0.5
    =${GLUE_tscaltemp}mm
(2)荷载作用下胶缝厚度的计算:
   Ts: 荷载作用下结构胶的粘结厚度: mm   
    H: 幕墙分格高: ${GLUE_Hw}m
   θ:幕墙层间变位设计变位角1/${GetRecip(GLUE_STRUCTRADTRUE)}${IsEqual(GLUE_DEPRE,1):*
   ψ:胶缝变位折减系数${GLUE_DEPRE}}
   δ2: 结构硅酮密封胶的地震变位承受能力: ${GLUE_RADLAY}
   Ts=${GLUE_EQUAKELAYER:+${GLUE_EQUAKERATIO}×}θ×H×${IsEqual(GLUE_DEPRE,1):*ψ×}1000/(δ2×(2+δ2))^0.5
      =${GLUE_EQUAKELAYER:+${GLUE_EQUAKERATIO}×}1/${GetRecip(GLUE_STRUCTRADTRUE)}×${GLUE_Hw}×${IsEqual(GLUE_DEPRE,1):*${GLUE_DEPRE}×}1000/(${GLUE_RADLAY}×(2+${GLUE_RADLAY}))^0.5
      =${GLUE_tscallay}mm
(3)结构硅酮密封胶的最小计算厚度: ${Ceil(GLUE_tscal)}mm

(1)温度变化效应胶缝厚度的计算:
   Ts: 温度变化效应结构胶的粘结厚度: mm
   δ1: 结构硅酮密封胶的温差变位承受能力: ${GLUE_RADTMP}
   △Ｔ: 年温差: ${GLOB_TEMPDIFF}℃
   Us: 玻璃板块在年温差作用下玻璃与铝型材相对位移量: mm
   铝型材线膨胀系数: al=2.35×10^-5
   玻璃线膨胀系数: aw=1×10^-5

    =${GLUE_ustemp}mm
  Ts=Us/(δ1×(2+δ1))^0.5                     (JGJ102-2003  5.6.5)
    =${GLUE_ustemp}/(${GLUE_RADTMP}×(2+${GLUE_RADTMP}))^0.5
    =${GLUE_tscaltemp}mm
(2)地震作用下胶缝厚度的计算:
   Ts: 地震作用下结构胶的粘结厚度: mm  
    H: 幕墙分格高: ${GLUE_Hw}m
   θ:幕墙层间变位设计变位角1/${GetRecip(GLUE_STRUCTRADTRUE)}${IsEqual(GLUE_DEPRE,1):*
   ψ:胶缝变位折减系数${GLUE_DEPRE}}
   δ2: 结构硅酮密封胶的地震变位承受能力: ${GLUE_RADLAY}

      =${GLUE_EQUAKELAYER:+${GLUE_EQUAKERATIO}×}1/${GetRecip(GLUE_STRUCTRADTRUE)}×${GLUE_Hw}×${IsEqual(GLUE_DEPRE,1):*${GLUE_DEPRE}×}1000/(${GLUE_RADLAY}×(2+${GLUE_RADLAY}))^0.5
      =${GLUE_tscallay}mm 
(3)结构硅酮密封胶的最小计算厚度: ${Ceil(GLUE_tscal)}mm

(1)设计选定胶缝宽度和厚度:
    ${GLUE_DRAWID:+${GLUE_DRAWDESC}\:
    ${XDrawProfileEX(GLUE_DRAWID,GLUE_DRAWSLD,GLUE_DRAWDESC)}
    }胶缝选定宽度为: ${GLUE_CS} mm 
    胶缝选定厚度为: ${GLUE_TS} mm  ${GLUE_TLESS:*
    由于${GLUE_tscal}${GetLess(GLUE_TLESS)}${GLUE_TS},结构胶厚度${GetOKStr(GLUE_TLESS)}满足要求}${GLUE_GLESS:*
    构造要求：厚度不应小于6mm且不应大于12mm,宽度不应小于7mm,宽度不宜大于厚度的2倍，厚度不大于宽度。所以胶缝${GetOKStr(GLUE_GLESS)}满足构造要求} ${IsNEqual(GLUE_YKTYPE,2):+
    幕墙玻璃相对于铝合金框的位移\:

(2)短期荷载和作用在结构胶中产生的拉应力:
   W: 风荷载以及地震荷载组合设计值${GLUE_COMP}kN/m^2
   ${IsEqual(GLUE_YKTYPE,0):+a\: 矩形分格短边长度\: ${GLUE_SHORTSIDE}m}${IsEqual(GLUE_YKTYPE,0):*a\: 玻璃结构胶单边长度\: ${GLUE_SHORTSIDE}m}

   B\: 幕墙分格宽\: ${GLUE_Bw}m   ${IsNLarge(GLUE_YKTYPE,1):+
   σ2=GA×B×H/Cs/2/(B+H)
     =${Mul(GLUE_GAK,GLUE_Gratio)}×${GLUE_Bw}×${GLUE_Hw}/${GLUE_CS}/2/(${GLUE_Bw}+${GLUE_Hw})

(1).场地类别划分:
   根据地面粗糙度,场地可划分为以下类别:
   A类近海面,海岛,海岸,湖岸及沙漠地区;
   B类指田野,乡村,丛林,丘陵以及房屋比较稀疏的乡镇;
   C类指有密集建筑群的城市市区;
   D类指有密集建筑群且房屋较高的城市市区;
   ${PROJECTNAME}按${REGION}类地区计算风压
(2).风荷载计算:
   幕墙属于薄壁外围护构件
   风荷载计算公式: Wk=βgz×K1×K2×μsl×μz×W0
   其中: Wk---作用在幕墙上的风荷载标准值(kN/m^2)
        βgz---瞬时风压的阵风系数
              根据不同场地类型,按以下公式计算:βgz=1+2gI10(z/10)^(-α)
              其中g为峰值因子取为${GLOB_g}，I10为10米高名义湍流度,α为地面粗糙度指数
              A类场地: I10=0.12  ,α=0.12
              B类场地: I10=0.14  ,α=0.15
              C类场地: I10=0.23  ,α=0.22
              D类场地: I10=0.39  ,α=0.30
        μz---风压高度变化系数
              根据不同场地类型,按以下公式计算:
              A类场地: μz=1.284×(Z/10)^0.24
              B类场地: μz=1.000×(Z/10)^0.30
              C类场地: μz=0.544×(Z/10)^0.44
              D类场地: μz=0.262×(Z/10)^0.60
              本工程属于${REGION}类地区
        μsl---局部风压体型系数,按${GLOB_LC_GD:*《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2012}${GLOB_LC_GD:+《建筑结构荷载规范》DBJ/T 15-101-2022}取定
        W0---基本风压,按全国基本风压图,${CITYNAME}地区取为${ω0}kN/m^2
        K1: 地形修正系数
        K2: 风向影响系数
(3).地震作用计算:
   qEAk=βE×Fa×αmaxii×GAK
   其中: qEAk---水平地震作用标准值
         βE---动力放大系数,按 5.0 取定
         αmaxii---水平地震影响系数最大值,按相应设防烈度取定
              ${CITYNAME}地区设防烈度为${GetAntiEQLevelString(DegOfEq)},根据本地区的情况,取αmax=Fa×αmaxii=${EqAMaxFa}×${EqAMax2}=${EqAMax}
         GAK---幕墙构件的自重(N/m^2)
(4).荷载组合:
   结构设计时，根据构件受力特点，荷载或作用的情况和产生的应力(内力)作用方向，选用最不利的组合，荷载和效应组合设计值按下式采用：
    γGSG+γwψwSw+γEψESE+γTψTST
    各项分别为永久荷载：重力；可变荷载：风荷载、温度变化；偶然荷载：地震
   荷载和作用效应组合的分项系数,按以下规定采用:
   ①对永久荷载采用标准值作为代表值，其分项系数满足：
     a.当其效应对结构不利时：对由可变荷载效应控制的组合，取${γGf}
     b.当其效应对结构有利时：一般情况取1.0；
   ②可变荷载根据设计要求选代表值，其分项系数一般情况取${γqf}

   螺栓群在通过其形心的剪力和轴力作用下，每个螺栓受力相同，每个螺栓受力为
   Nv =V/n
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_ForceV}×10^3/${GetBoltNumber(BOLTLKJLNM_Layout)}
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_Nv}N
   Nn =N/n
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_ForceN}×10^3/${GetBoltNumber(BOLTLKJLNM_Layout)}
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_Nn}N
   螺栓群在弯矩作用下，每个螺栓实际受剪。计算时假定连接构件是绝对刚性的，螺栓是弹性的，所以螺栓都绕螺栓群的形心旋转，其受力大小与到螺栓群形心的距离成正比，方向与螺栓到形心的连线垂直。
   根据图示可知，螺栓形心坐标为[${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[0]},${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[1]}]，离形心最远点为${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[6]}号点，该点坐标为[${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[3]},${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[4]}]，计算各螺栓到形心点的距离得到
   ∑r^2=${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[2]}

   Nmy=M×Δx/∑r^2
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_ForceM}×10^6×${Abs(Sub(BOLTLKJLNM_Center[3],BOLTLKJLNM_Center[0]))}/${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[2]}
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_Nmy}N

      =${BOLTLKJLNM_ForceM}×10^6×${Abs(Sub(BOLTLKJLNM_Center[4],BOLTLKJLNM_Center[1]))}/${BOLTLKJLNM_Center[2]}
      =${BOLTLKJLNM_Nmx}N
   所以，在弯矩、剪力和轴力共同作用下，螺栓受力最大值为：
   Nmax=((Nmx+Nn)^2+(Nmy+Nv)^2)^0.5

       =${BOLTLKJLNM_Nmax}N${GetLess(BOLTLKJLNM_Strength)}[N]bv=${BOLTLKJLNM_NVb}N

   (1)冬季标准计算条件应为：
     室内空气温度：Tin=20℃；

     室内对流换热系数：hc,in=3.6W/(m^2·K)；
     室外对流换热系数：hc,out=16W/(m^2·K)；
     室内平均辐射温度：Trm,in=Tin
     室外平均辐射温度：Trm,out=Tout
     太阳辐射照度：Is=300W/m^2；
  (2)夏季标准计算条件应为：
     室内空气温度：Tin=25℃；
     室外空气温度：Tout=30℃；
     室内对流换热系数：hc,in=2.5W/(m^2·K)；
     室外对流换热系数：hc,out=16W/(m^2·K)；
     室内平均辐射温度：Trm,in=Tin
     室外平均辐射温度：Trm,out=Tout
     太阳辐射照度：Is=500W/m^2;
  (3)计算基础及依据     
     U值是表示玻璃传热的参数,表示热量通过玻璃中心部位而不考虑边缘效应，稳态条件下，玻璃两表面在单位环境温度差条件时，通过单位面积的热量。U值的单位是W/(m^2·K)。
　   按规范JGJ/T151-2008 6.4.1规定，计算玻璃的传热系数时应采用简单的模拟环境条件,仅考虑室内外温差,没有太阳辐射,应按下面的公式计算：
     Ug=1/Rt      (JGJ/T151-2008  6.4.1-2)
     玻璃系统的传热阻Rt应为各层玻璃、气体间层、内外表面换热阻之和，应按下列公式计算：
     Rt=1/hout+∑Ri+∑Rgi+1/hin    (JGJ/T151-2008  6.4.1-3)
     Rgi=tgi/λgi                 (JGJ/T151-2008  6.4.1-4)
     Ri=(Tfi-Tbi1)/qi            (JGJ/T151-2008  6.4.1-5)
     qi=hci×(Tfi-Tbi1)+hri×(Tfi-Tbi1)   (JGJ/T151-2008  6.3.1-6)
     式中：
         Rgi：第i层玻璃等固体材料的固体热阻(m^2·K/W)；
 　      Ri：第i层气体间层的热阻(m^2·K/W)；
         Tfi、Tbi1：第i层气体间层的外表面和内表面的温度(K)；
         qi：第i层气体间层的热流密度。

外表面或内表面的换热系数应按下式计算：
   h = hr + hc      (JGJ/T151-2008 10.4.1-2)
   式中 hr : 辐射换热系数
        hc : 对流换热系数
  (1).室外表面换热系数
   按照上面公式有
    hout=hr,out+hc,out     
   式中：
    hout：玻璃外表面的换热系数；
    hr,out：玻璃外表面的辐射换热系数；
    hc,out：玻璃外表面的对流换热系数，按规范取${KVALUE_Outer}W/(m^2·K)；
    hr,out=3.9×εs,out/0.837      (JGJ/T151-2008  10.3.5-3)
   式中：
    εs,out：玻璃外表面半球发射率；取${KVALUE_GlassCR}
    hout=hr,out+hc,out
    　=3.9×${KVALUE_GlassCR}/0.837+${KVALUE_Outer}
      =${KVALUE_Ho}W/(m^2·K)
   (2).室内表面换热系数
   室内表面换热系数hin可用下式表达：
   hin = hr,in + hc,in               
   式中：
    hin：玻璃内表面的换热系数；
    hr,in：玻璃内表面的辐射换热系数；
    hc,in：玻璃内表面的对流换热系数，按规范取${KVALUE_Inter}W/(m^2·K)；
    hr,in=4.4×εs/0.837      (JGJ/T151-2008  10.3.4-4)
   式中：
    εs = 1/(1/εsurf+1/εs,in-1)    (JGJ/T151-2008  10.3.4-3)
    εs,in：室内环境材料的平均发射率,一般可取0.9
    εsurf: 玻璃内表面发射率,由厂家给出；本处取${KVALUE_GlassCR}
    εs = 1/(1/εsurf+1/εs,in-1)
       = 1/(1/${KVALUE_GlassCR} + 1/0.9 - 1)
       = ${KVALUE_InterCR}
    对于通常情况下的玻璃表面辐射和自由对流：
    hin=hr,in+hc,in

   r1,r2,r3\:外层、中间层、内层玻璃荷载分配系数
   r1 =t1^3/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
      =${GLSPS_to}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)
      =${GLSPS_RGLASS0}
   r2 =t2^3/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
      =${GLSPS_tmg}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)
      =${GLSPS_RGLASS1}
   r3 =t3^3/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
      =${GLSPS_ti}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)
      =${GLSPS_RGLASS2} }${LAnd(IsNLarge(GLSPS_tm,3),IsNLess(GLSPS_tml,3)):+

   tew=(t1^3+t2^3)^(1/3)
   rew\:外层夹胶组合分配系数
   rew=1.1×tew^3/(tew^3+t3^3)
      =1.1×(t1^3+t2^3)/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
   r1,r2,r3\:外层、中间层、内层玻璃荷载分配系数
   r1 =rew×t1^3/(t1^3+t2^3)
      =1.1×(t1^3+t2^3)/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)×t1^3/(t1^3+t2^3)
      =1.1×${GLSPS_to}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)
      =${GLSPS_RGLASS0}
   r2 =rew×t2^3/(t1^3+t2^3)
      =1.1×t2^3/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
      =1.1×${GLSPS_tmg}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)
      =${GLSPS_RGLASS1}
   r3 =t3^3/(tew^3+t3^3)
      =t3^3/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
      =${GLSPS_ti}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)

   ren\:内层夹胶组合分配系数
   ren=ten^3/(ten^3+t1^3)
      =(t2^3+t3^3)/(t2^3+t3^3+t1^3)
   r1,r2,r3\:外层、中间层、内层玻璃荷载分配系数
   r1 =1.1×t1^3/(t1^3+ten^3)
      =1.1×t1^3/(t1^3+t2^3+t3^3)
      =1.1×${GLSPS_to}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)
      =${GLSPS_RGLASS0}

      =${GLSPS_tmg}^3/(${GLSPS_to}^3+${GLSPS_tmg}^3+${GLSPS_ti}^3)

螺栓布置示意图如下:
   ${GetBoltLinkDrawing(BOLTLKDNMV_Layout,BOLTLKDNMV_Length,BOLTLKDNMV_Width)}
   d:锚栓直径${BOLTLKDNMV_D}mm
   de:锚栓有效直径为${GetDe(BOLTLKDNMV_D)}mm
   d0:锚栓孔直径${BOLTLKDNMV_D0}mm
   一个锚栓的抗剪承载力设计值为
   Nvb=nv×π×d^2/4×fvb                                  (GB50017-2017  11.4.1-1)
      =1×π×${BOLTLKDNMV_D}^2/4×${GetFt(BOLTLKDNMV_BOLTM,0)}
      =${GetBoltNvb(BOLTLKDNMV_D,1,BOLTLKDNMV_BOLTM)}N
   t:锚板厚度，为${BOLTLKDNMV_TT}mm
   一个锚栓的承压承载力设计值为
   Ncb=d×t×fcb                                         (GB50017-2017  11.4.1-3)
      =${BOLTLKDNMV_D}×${BOLTLKDNMV_TT}×${GetFc(ANBOLTMATERIAL)}
      =${GetBoltNcb(BOLTLKDNMV_D,BOLTLKDNMV_TT,ANBOLTMATERIAL)}N
   一个拉力锚栓的承载力设计值为
   Ntb=π×de^2/4×ftb                                    (GB50017-2017  11.4.1-6)
      =π×${GetDe(BOLTLKDNMV_D)}^2/4×${GetFa(ANBOLTMATERIAL)}
      =${BOLTLKDNMV_Tb}N
   在轴力和弯矩共同作用下，锚栓群有两种可能的受力形式。
   首先假定锚栓群绕自身的中心进行转动，经过分析得到锚栓群形心坐标为[${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[0]},${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1]}]，各锚栓到锚栓形心点的Y向距离平方之和为
   ∑y^2=${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[2]}
   y坐标最高的锚栓为${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[5]}号锚栓，该点的y坐标为${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4]}，该点到形心点的y向距离为
   y1= ${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4]}-${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1]} = ${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1])}mm 
   y坐标最低的锚栓为${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[7]}号锚栓，该点的y坐标为${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6]}，该点到形心点的y向距离为
   y2= ${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6]}-${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1]} = ${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1])}mm  
   所以各点到螺栓群中心点最大距离为y3=${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[9]}
   所以锚栓群的最大和最小受力为：
   Nmin=N/n - M×y3/∑y^2
       =${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceN}×10^3/${GetBoltNumber(BOLTLKDNMV_Layout)}-(${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceM}×10^6)×${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[9]}/${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[2]}
       =${BOLTLKDNMV_Nminf}N
   Nmax=N/n + M×y3/∑y^2
       =${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceN}×10^3/${GetBoltNumber(BOLTLKDNMV_Layout)}+(${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceM}×10^6)×${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[9]}/${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[2]}
       =${BOLTLKDNMV_Nmaxf}N    ${IsLess(Mul(BOLTLKDNMV_Nminf,BOLTLKDNMV_Nmaxf),0):+${IsLess(BOLTLKDNMV_Nminf,0):+
   由于Nmin<0，说明连接下部受压，在弯矩作用下构件绕最底排锚栓转动，此时，分析计算得到各锚栓到底排锚栓的Y向距离平方之和为
   ∑yd^2=${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[3]}
   最高锚栓点到底排锚栓点的y向距离为
   yd= ${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4]}-${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6]} = ${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6])}mm  
   e\:轴力作用点到锚栓群转动中心的距离为${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6])}mm
   锚栓最大受力为   
   Nmax=(M+N×e)×yd/∑yd^2
       =(${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceM}×10^6+${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceN}×1000×${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6])})×${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6])}/${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[3]}
       =${BOLTLKDNMV_Nmaxb}N   }${IsLess(BOLTLKDNMV_Nminf,0):*
   由于Nmax<0，说明连接上部受压，在弯矩作用下构件绕最顶排锚栓转动，此时，分析计算得到各锚栓到顶排锚栓的Y向距离平方之和为
   ∑yd^2=${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[8]}
   最高锚栓点到底排锚栓点的y向距离为
   yd= ${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4]}-${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6]} = ${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6])}mm  
   e\:轴力作用点到锚栓群转动中心的距离为${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1])}mm
   锚栓最大受力为   
   Nmax=(N×e-M)×yd/∑yd^2
       =(${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceN}×1000×${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[1])}-(${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceM}×10^6))×${Sub(BOLTLKDNMV_Center[4],BOLTLKDNMV_Center[6])}/${BOLTLKDNMV_Center[8]}
       =${BOLTLKDNMV_Nminb}N }}
   单个锚栓承受的剪力为
   Nv=V/n
     =${BOLTLKDNMV_ForceV}×10^3/${GetBoltNumber(BOLTLKDNMV_Layout)}
     =${BOLTLKDNMV_V}N
   由以上计算得知:
   螺栓承受的最大拉拔力Nt=${BOLTLKDNMV_T}N
   螺栓承受的最大压力Ny=${BOLTLKDNMV_Y}N
   强度验算
    ((Nv/Nvb)^2+(Nt/Ntb)^2)^0.5                           (GB50017-2017  11.4.1-8)
    =((${BOLTLKDNMV_V}/${GetBoltNvb(BOLTLKDNMV_D,1,BOLTLKDNMV_BOLTM)})^2+(${BOLTLKDNMV_T}/${BOLTLKDNMV_Tb})^2)^0.5
    =${BOLTLKDNMV_TStrength}${GetLess(BOLTLKDNMV_Strength)}1
   Nv=${BOLTLKDNMV_V}N${GetLess(BOLTLKDNMV_VStrength)}Ncb=${GetBoltNcb(BOLTLKDNMV_D,BOLTLKDNMV_TT,ANBOLTMATERIAL)}N                            (GB50017-2017  11.4.1-9)
   锚栓最大拉拔力为Nmax=${BOLTLKDNMV_T}N${GetLess(BOLTLKDNMV_StrengthV)}[Nmax]=${Mul(BOLTLKDNMV_NCT,1000)}N，${GetOKStr(BOLTLKDNMV_StrengthV)}满足要求 
   所以锚栓强度${GetOKStr(Mul(BOLTLKDNMV_VStrength,BOLTLKDNMV_Strength))}满足要求

玻璃肋结构:${GetRibGlassDesc(GRIB_STRUCT,GRIB_FilmType)}
   b: 玻璃肋的等效厚度: ${GRIB_b}mm
   d: 玻璃肋的截面高度 ${GRIB_H}mm
   当前玻璃肋稳定性按照${GRIB_ConstType:+无}侧边约束计算
   玻璃肋处于室${GRIB_Indoors:*内}${GRIB_Indoors:+外}
   玻璃肋所承受的弯矩为:
   正风组合荷载作用下
   Mp=1/8×q×B×Hcal^2
    =1/8×${GRIB_COMPP}×${GRIB_Bw}×${GRIB_Hw}^2
    =${GRIB_Mp}kN.m
   负风组合荷载作用下
   Mn=1/8×q×B×Hcal^2
    =1/8×(${GRIB_COMPN})×${GRIB_Bw}×${GRIB_Hw}^2
    =${GRIB_Mn}kN.m   
   屈曲临界临界弯矩计算公式 ${GRIB_ConstType:*
   Mcr = [(π/Lay)^2×E×Iy×(d^2/12 + Y0^2) + GJ]/(2Y0+Yh)  }${GRIB_ConstType:+
   Mcr = (g2/Lay).(E×Iy×GJ)^0.5×[1-g3×(Yh/Lay)×(E×Iy/GJ)^0.5]    }
   上式中，Iy为侧向惯性矩
   Iy=1/12×d×b^3
     =1/12×${GRIB_H}×${GRIB_b}^3
     =${GRIB_Iy}mm^4  ${GRIB_ConstType:+
   g2\: 屈曲系数 取${GRIB_g2}
   g3\: 屈曲系数 取${GRIB_g3} }
   J为玻璃肋抗扭惯性矩
   J = db^3×(1-0.63b/d)/3
     = ${GRIB_H}×${GRIB_b}^3×(1-0.63×${GRIB_b}/${GRIB_H})/3
     = ${GRIB_J}mm^4
   G: 为玻璃的剪切模量G=E/2(1+γ)=${GetE(GRIB_GLASSNAME)}/2/(1+${GetVr(GRIB_GLASSNAME)})=${GRIB_G}
   L为玻璃肋的跨度为${GRIB_Hw}m
   正风压作用下Yhp = ${GRIB_yhp}mm
   负风压作用下Yhn = ${GRIB_yhn}mm
   Y0 = d/2 = ${GRIB_yo}mm
   在正风压组合作用下  ${GRIB_ConstType:*
   Mcrp = [(π/Lay)^2×E×Iy×(d^2/12 + Y0^2) + GJ]/(2Y0+Yhp)
        = [(π/(${GRIB_Hw}×1000))^2×E×${GRIB_Iy}×(${GRIB_H}^2/12 + ${GRIB_yo}^2) + ${GRIB_G}×${GRIB_J}]/(2×${GRIB_yo}+(${GRIB_yhp})/1000000
        = ${GRIB_Mcrap}kN.m   } ${GRIB_ConstType:+
   Mcrp = (g2/Lay)×(E×Iy×GJ)^0.5×[1-g3×(Yhp/Lay)×(E×Iy/GJ)^0.5]
        = (${GRIB_g2}/(${GRIB_Hw}×1000))×(E×${GRIB_Iy}×${GRIB_G}×${GRIB_J})^0.5×[1-${GRIB_g3}×(${GRIB_yhp}/(${GRIB_Hw}×1000)×(E×${GRIB_Iy}/(${GRIB_G}×${GRIB_J}))^0.5]/1000000
        = ${GRIB_Mcrbp}kN.m   }
   在负风压组合作用下  ${GRIB_ConstType:*
   Mcrn = [(π/Lay)^2×E×Iy×(d^2/12 + Y0^2) + GJ]/(2Y0+Yhn)
        = [(π/(${GRIB_Hw}×1000))^2×E×${GRIB_Iy}×(${GRIB_H}^2/12 + ${GRIB_yo}^2) + ${GRIB_G}×${GRIB_J}]/(2×${GRIB_yo}+(${GRIB_yhn})/1000000
        = ${GRIB_Mcran}kN.m   }${GRIB_ConstType:+
   Mcrn = (g2/Lay)×(E×Iy×GJ)^0.5×[1-g3×(Yhn/Lay)×(E×Iy/GJ)^0.5]
        = (${GRIB_g2}/(${GRIB_Hw}×1000))×(E×${GRIB_Iy}×${GRIB_G}×${GRIB_J})^0.5×[1-${GRIB_g3}×(${GRIB_yhn}/(${GRIB_Hw}×1000)×(E×${GRIB_Iy}/(${GRIB_G}×${GRIB_J}))^0.5]/1000000
        = ${GRIB_Mcrbn}kN.m   }
   由于 Mp=1.14×${GRIB_Mp}kN.m ${GetLess(GRIB_WLESSp)}${GRIB_Mcrp} 所以玻璃肋在正风组合作用下稳定性${GetOKStr(GRIB_WLESSp)}满足要求。
   由于 Mn=1.14×${GRIB_Mn}kN.m ${GetLess(GRIB_WLESSn)}${GRIB_Mcrn} 所以玻璃肋在负风组合作用下稳定性${GetOKStr(GRIB_WLESSn)}满足要求。

本计算依据《钢结构设计标准》 GB50017-2017第11.6节，主要参数图示如下

    ${XDrawProfileEX(EARBOARD_DRAWID,EARBOARD_DRAWSLD)}}
    d0: 销轴孔径为${EARBOARD_D0}mm
    N: 耳板所受外拉力为${EARBOARD_FORCE}kN
   Ns: 端耳板所受的外拉力为上面拉力的一半，取${EARBOARD_FORCEB}kN
    t: 端耳板厚度为${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}mm
    a: 顺受力方向，端耳板销轴孔边距板边缘最小距离${EARBOARD_A}mm
    b: 连接端耳板两侧边缘与销轴孔边缘净距离${EARBOARD_B}mm
    tm: 中间耳板厚度${EARBOARD_Tm}mm
    am: 顺受力方向，中间耳板销轴孔边距板边缘最小距离${EARBOARD_Am}mm
    bm: 连接中间耳板两侧边缘与销轴孔边缘净距离${EARBOARD_Bm}mm
     s: 端耳板与中间耳板间的间距${EARBOARD_S}mm
    耳板材质: ${EARBOARD_MATERIAL}
    连接销轴材质:${EARBOARD_BOLTMATERIAL}
    d: 连接销轴直径${EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM}mm
    耳板采用${EARBOARD_LINKTYPE:+焊接}${EARBOARD_LINKTYPE:*螺栓}方式与结构体连接
    ${EARBOARD_LINKTYPE:+焊接采用${EARBOARD_WELDTYPE:*角焊缝}${EARBOARD_WELDTYPE:+对接焊缝}方式}${EARBOARD_LINKTYPE:*连接螺栓材质为${EARBOARD_LINKBMATERIAL}
    连接螺栓直径为${EARBOARD_LINKBDIAM}mm}

1)中间耳板  
   bm1= min(2×tm+16,bm-d0/3)
      = min(2×${EARBOARD_Tm}+16,${EARBOARD_Bm}-${EARBOARD_D0}/3)
      = ${EARBOARD_Bm1}mm
    σ: 中间耳板孔净截面处的抗拉强度 
    σ = N/(2×tm×bm1)
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/(2×${EARBOARD_Tm}×${EARBOARD_Bm1})
       = ${EARBOARD_LADUANm}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_STRLESSm)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_Tm)}N/mm^2
    所以中间耳板孔净截面处的抗拉强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_STRLESSm)}满足强度要求
  2)端部耳板
    b1= min(2×t+16,b-d0/3)
      = min(2×${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}+16,${EARBOARD_B}-${EARBOARD_D0}/3)
      = ${EARBOARD_B1}mm
    σ: 端部耳板孔净截面处的抗拉强度 
    σ = Ns/(2×t×b1)
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCEB}×1000/(2×${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}×${EARBOARD_B1})
       = ${EARBOARD_LADUAN}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_STRLESS)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_THICKNESS)}N/mm^2
    所以端部耳板孔净截面处的抗拉强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_STRLESS)}满足强度要求

σ: B-B截面弯曲应力
    b: 最危险截面B-B的宽度 ${EARBOARD_BB}mm
    拉力与最危险截面B-B中心的偏心距
    e = r + b/2
      = ${Div(EARBOARD_D0,2)} + ${EARBOARD_BB}/2
      = ${EARBOARD_BBDIST}mm
    M: B-B截面弯矩
    M = F×e
      = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000×${EARBOARD_BBDIST}
      = ${EARBOARD_BBM}N.mm
    W: B-B截面抵抗矩
    W = t×b^2/6
      = ${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}×${EARBOARD_BB}^2/6
      = ${EARBOARD_BBW}mm^3
    σ = M/W
      = ${EARBOARD_BBM}/${EARBOARD_BBW}
      = ${EARBOARD_BBLADUAN}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_STRLESS)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_THICKNESS)}N/mm^2
    所以,耳板弯曲应力${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_STRLESS)}满足强度要求

σ: B-B截面弯曲应力
    b: 最危险截面B-B的宽度 ${EARBOARD_BB}mm
    拉力与最危险截面B-B中心的偏心距
    e = r + b/2
      = ${EARBOARD_INNERR} + ${EARBOARD_BB}/2
      = ${EARBOARD_BBDIST}mm
    M: B-B截面弯矩
    M = F×e
      = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000×${EARBOARD_BBDIST}
      = ${EARBOARD_BBM}N.mm
    W: B-B截面抵抗矩
    W = t×b^2/6
      = ${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}×${EARBOARD_BB}^2/6
      = ${EARBOARD_BBW}mm^3
    σ = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(M,W)${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${EARBOARD_BBM},${EARBOARD_BBW})${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${EARBOARD_BBLADUAN}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_STRLESS)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_THICKNESS)}N/mm^2

1)中间耳板  
    Z: 中间耳板抗剪截面宽度
    Z = √((am+d0/2)^2-(d0/2)^2)
      = √((${EARBOARD_Am}+${EARBOARD_D0}/2)^2-(${EARBOARD_D0}/2)^2)
      = ${EARBOARD_Zm}mm
    τ = N/(2×tm×Z)
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/(2×${EARBOARD_Tm}×${EARBOARD_Zm})
       = ${EARBOARD_JIANDUANm}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_SHEARLESSm)} ${GetFt(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_Tm)}N/mm^2
    所以中间耳板剪应力${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_SHEARLESSm)}满足强度要求
   2)端部耳板  
    Z: 端部耳板抗剪截面宽度
    Z = √((a+d0/2)^2-(d0/2)^2)
      = √((${EARBOARD_A}+${EARBOARD_D0}/2)^2-(${EARBOARD_D0}/2)^2)
      = ${EARBOARD_Z}mm
    τ = Ns/(2×t×Z)
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCEB}×1000/(2×${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}×${EARBOARD_Z})
       = ${EARBOARD_JIANDUAN}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_SHEARLESS)} ${GetFt(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_THICKNESS)}N/mm^2
    所以端部耳板剪应力${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_SHEARLESS)}满足强度要求

1)中部耳板
  σ: 耳板端部截面抗拉(劈裂)强度 
    σ = N/(2×tm×(am-2d0/3))
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/(2×${EARBOARD_Tm}×(${EARBOARD_Am}-2×${EARBOARD_D0}/3))
       = ${EARBOARD_DUANMIANm}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_PFSTRLESSm)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_Tm)}N/mm^2
    所以耳板端部截面抗拉(劈裂)强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_PFSTRLESSm)}满足要求
  根据《钢结构设计手册(第四版)》(下册)13.0.1节进行耳板的局部承压验算
    σp=2×N/(3^0.5×d×tm)
       =2×${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/(3^0.5×${EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM}×${EARBOARD_Tm})
       =${EARBOARD_PARTIALYSTRESSm}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_PARTIALYSTRESSLESSm)} ${GetFp(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_Tm)}N/mm^2
    所以中部耳板局部承压强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_PARTIALYSTRESSLESSm)}满足要求
  2)端部耳板
  σ: 耳板端部截面抗拉(劈裂)强度 
    σ = Ns/(2×t×(a-2d0/3))
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCEB}×1000/(2×${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}×(${EARBOARD_A}-2×${EARBOARD_D0}/3))
       = ${EARBOARD_DUANMIAN}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_PFSTRLESS)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_THICKNESS)}N/mm^2
    所以耳板端部截面抗拉(劈裂)强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_PFSTRLESS)}满足要求
    σp=2×Ns/(3^0.5×d×t)
       =2×${EARBOARD_FORCEB}×1000/(3^0.5×${EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM}×${EARBOARD_THICKNESS})
       =${EARBOARD_PARTIALYSTRESS}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_PARTIALYSTRESSLESS)} ${GetFp(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_THICKNESS)}N/mm^2
    所以端部耳板局部承压强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_PARTIALYSTRESSLESS)}满足要求

1)、销轴承压强度
    σc= N/(d×tm)
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/(${EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM}×${EARBOARD_Tm})
       = ${EARBOARD_BOLTSTRESSC}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_BOLTCLESS)} ${GetFp(EARBOARD_MATERIAL,EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM)}N/mm^2
    所以销轴承压强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_BOLTCLESS)}满足要求
   2)、销轴抗剪强度
    τb= N/(2×π×d^2/4)
       = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/(2×π×${EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM}^2/4)
       = ${EARBOARD_BOLTSHEAR}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_BOLTSHEARLESS)} ${GetFt(EARBOARD_BOLTMATERIAL,EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM)}N/mm^2
    所以销轴剪应力${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_BOLTSHEARLESS)}满足强度要求
   3)、销轴的抗弯强度
    M = N/8×(2×te+tm+4×s) 
      = ${EARBOARD_FORCE}×1000/8×(2×${EARBOARD_THICKNESS}+${EARBOARD_Tm}+4×${EARBOARD_S})
      = ${EARBOARD_M}N.mm
    σb= M/(1.5×π×d^3/32)
       = ${EARBOARD_M}/(1.5×π×${EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM}^3/32)
       = ${EARBOARD_BOLTSTRESSB}  N/mm^2 ${GetLess(EARBOARD_BOLTBLESS)} ${GetFa(EARBOARD_BOLTMATERIAL,EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM)}N/mm^2
    所以销轴抗弯强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_BOLTBLESS)}满足要求
   4)、截面同时受弯受剪时组合强度验算
    √((σb/fb)^2+(τb/fv)^2)
    =√((${EARBOARD_BOLTSTRESSB}/${GetFa(EARBOARD_BOLTMATERIAL,EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM)})^2+(${EARBOARD_BOLTSHEAR}/${GetFt(EARBOARD_BOLTMATERIAL,EARBOARD_BOLTDIAM)})^2)
    = ${EARBOARD_COMBSTRESS} ${GetLess(EARBOARD_BOLTCOMBLESS)}1
    所以销轴截面组合强度${GetOKStr(EARBOARD_BOLTCOMBLESS)}满足要求

${EARBOARD_WELDTYPE:+耳板与主体结构焊接,采用坡口焊对接焊接连接,可以达到与耳板等强连接,故焊缝满足要求}${EARBOARD_WELDTYPE:*耳板与主体结构焊接,采用角焊缝焊接连接
   F\: 通过焊缝中心作用的轴向力\:${EARBOARD_FORCE}kN

   N\: 垂直于焊缝方向的分力
   V\: 平行于焊缝方向的分力
   hf\:角焊缝的焊脚尺寸为${EARBOARD_WELDHEIGHT}mm
   lw\:角焊缝的计算长度为${EARBOARD_WELDLENGTH}mm
   Af\:角焊缝有效截面面积
   βf\:正面角焊缝(端焊缝)的强度设计增大系数，对承受静力荷载和间接承受动力荷载的结构取1.22；对直接承受动力荷载的结构取1.0
   fwt\:角焊缝的强度设计值取${GetWeldFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL)}N/mm^2

   ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','wt')}\:角焊缝的强度设计值取${GetWeldFa(EARBOARD_MATERIAL)}N/mm^2
   N = F×sinθ

   V = F×cosθ

     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1,2)${GetEQFormat(1)} × ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r((\\f(${EARBOARD_WELDN},${EARBOARD_WELDAF}×1.22))^2 + (\\f(${EARBOARD_WELDV},${EARBOARD_WELDAF}))^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}

化学植筋布置示意图如下:

       =${CHEMBOLT_nminf}N

1)植筋钢材破坏校核

   其中Nhsd : 植筋群中拉力最大的植筋的拉力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}N

   γrsn\:植筋钢材破坏受拉承载力分项系数,按表4.2.6采用
   fstk = ${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}N/mm^2
   fyk = ${GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}N/mm^2
   γrsn = ${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+1.3}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*1.2}×fstk/fyk 
        = ${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+${Mul(1.3,Div(GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL),GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)))}}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*${Mul(1.2,Div(GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL),GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)))}}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+${GetLess(IsEqual(CHEMBOLT_γrsn,1.55))}1.55}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*${GetLess(IsEqual(CHEMBOLT_γrsn,1.4))}1.4} 按表4.2.6取${CHEMBOLT_γrsn}

        = ${CHEMBOLT_As}×${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrks}N

        = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrks}/${CHEMBOLT_γrsn}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrds}N 
   由于 Nhsd=${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}N${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_STEELLESS)}Nrds,所以植筋钢材${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_STEELLESS)}满足强度要求
   考虑拉拔安全系数${CHEMBOLT_SAFERATIO},则锚栓拉拔试验强度值最少要求达到${CHEMBOLT_LBFORCE}kN}

1)植筋钢材受剪破坏校核
   校核依据 Vhsd ≤ Vrds                      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.1)
   其中Vhsd : 植筋群中剪力最大的植筋的剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}N  
       Vrds : 植筋钢材破坏受剪承载力设计值
   As: 植筋应力截面面积为${CHEMBOLT_As}mm^2
   fstk:植筋极限抗拉强度标准值
   Vrks:植筋钢材破坏受剪承载力标准值
   γrsv:植筋钢材破坏受剪承载力分项系数,按表4.2.6采用
   fstk = ${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}N/mm^2
   fyk = ${GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}N/mm^2
   γrsv = ${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+1.3}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*1.2}×fstk/fyk                   (JGJ145-2004 4.2.6) 
　　 　 =${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+1.3}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*1.2}×${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}/${GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}
　 　　 =${CHEMBOLT_γrsvcal}
   实际选取γrsv=${CHEMBOLT_γrsv}；
   不考虑杠杆臂的作用有
   Vrks = 0.5×As×fstk
        = 0.5×${CHEMBOLT_As}×${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrks}N
   Vrds = Vrks/γrsv
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrks}/${CHEMBOLT_γrsv}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrds}N 
   由于 Vhsd=${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}N${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_STEELVLESS)}Vrds,所以植筋钢材${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_STEELVLESS)}满足抗剪强度要求
   2)构件边缘受剪混凝土楔形体破坏校核   
   c: 植筋到混凝土边距,取c1=${CHEMBOLT_C1}mm和c2=${CHEMBOLT_C2}mm的较小值为${GetMin(CHEMBOLT_C1,CHEMBOLT_C2)}mm
   hef:植筋有效锚固深度为${CHEMBOLT_HEF}mm
   h: 混凝土基材厚度为${CHEMBOLT_H}mm
   由于c${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_CALCXXT)}10hef,所以需要效核混凝土承载力
   校核依据 Vgsd ≤ Vrdc                      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.1) 
   其中Vgsd : 植筋群总剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_FORCEV}N  
       Vrdc : 混凝土楔形体破坏时的受剪承载力设计值
   Vrdc = Vrkc/γrcv                          (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-1) 
   Vrkc =Vorkc×Acv/Aocv×ψsv×ψhv×ψav×ψecv×ψucrv             (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-2) 
   上式中
   Vrks :构件边缘混凝土破坏时受剪承载力标准值
   γrcv :构件边缘混凝土破坏时受剪承载力分项系数,按4.2.6取用,对于${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*非}结构构件,取${CHEMBOLT_γrcv}
   Vorkc:开裂混凝土,单根锚筋垂直构件边缘受剪,混凝土理想破坏时的受剪承载力标准值
   Aocv :单根锚筋受剪,混凝土破坏理想楔形体在侧向的投影面面积
   Acv  :群锚受剪,混凝土破坏理想楔形体在侧向的投影面面积
   ψsv  :边距比c2/c1对受剪承载力的降低影响系数
   ψhv  :边距与厚度比c1/h对受剪承载力的提高影响系数
   ψav  :剪力角度对受剪承载力的影响系数
   ψecv :荷载偏心ev对群锚受剪承载力的降低影响系数
   ψucrv:未开裂混凝土及锚区配筋对受剪承载力的提高影响系数,当前为${CHEMBOLT_SIDECONTYPEDESC},取${CHEMBOLT_ψucrv}
   以下分别对各参数进行计算
   dnom :植筋外径取${CHEMBOLT_D}mm
   lf   :剪切荷载作用下植筋的有效长度,给定值为${CHEMBOLT_LF}mm${IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_LF,Mul(8,CHEMBOLT_D)):+,按照规范要求lf≤8d,故取lf=8d=${Mul(8,CHEMBOLT_D)}mm}
   fcuk :混凝土立方体抗压强度标准值,当前级别${CHEMBOLT_CONLEVEL}
   Vorkc = 0.45×√dnom×(lf/dnom)^0.2×√fcuk×c1^1.5                   (JGJ145-2004 6.2.4) 
         = 0.45×√${CHEMBOLT_D}×(${CHEMBOLT_TLF}/${CHEMBOLT_D})^0.2×√${GetFcuk(CHEMBOLT_CONLEVEL)}×${CHEMBOLT_C1}^1.5
         = ${CHEMBOLT_Vorkc}N
   Aocv = 4.5×c1^2                                      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.5) 
        = 4.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1}^2
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Aocv}mm^2
   本处通常考虑四筋或以上作用,故
   s2 :垂直于剪力作用方向的外层植筋距离取${CHEMBOLT_S2}mm
   Acv = (1.5×c1+s2+c2)×h                              (JGJ145-2004 6.2.6-3) 
       = (1.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1}+${CHEMBOLT_S2}+${CHEMBOLT_C2})×${CHEMBOLT_H}
       = ${CHEMBOLT_Acv}mm^2
   ψsv = 0.7+0.3×c2/(1.5×c1)                           (JGJ145-2004 6.2.7) 
       = 0.7+0.3×${CHEMBOLT_C2}/(1.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1})
       =${CHEMBOLT_ψsvcal}${IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_ψsvcal,1):+>1,按照规范取1}
   ψhv = (1.5×c1/h)^(1/3)                            (JGJ145-2004 6.2.8) 
       = (1.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1}/${CHEMBOLT_H})^(1/3)
       = ${CHEMBOLT_ψhvcal}${IsLess(CHEMBOLT_ψhvcal,1):+<1,按照规范取1}
   由于剪力与垂直于构件自由边方向轴线的夹角为${CHEMBOLT_ANGLE}°,所以,按照规范JGJ145-2004 6.2.9有
   ψav = ${IsNLarge(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,55):+1.0}${IsNLess(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,90):+2.0}${Mul(IsLess(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,90),IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,55)):+1/(cosα+0.5sinα)
       = ${CHEMBOLT_ψav}}
   ev :剪力合力点到受剪锚筋重心的距离为${CHEMBOLT_EV}mm
   ψecv = 1/(1+2ev/(3c1))                               (JGJ145-2004 6.2.10) 
        = 1/(1+2×${CHEMBOLT_EV}/(3×${CHEMBOLT_C1}))
        = ${CHEMBOLT_ψecvcal}${IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_ψecvcal,1):+>1,按照规范取1}
   所以得到
   Vrkc =Vorkc×Acv/Aocv×ψsv×ψhv×ψav×ψecv×ψucrv                  (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-2) 
        =${CHEMBOLT_Vorkc}×${CHEMBOLT_Acv}/${CHEMBOLT_Aocv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψsv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψhv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψav}×${CHEMBOLT_ψecv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψucrv}
        =${CHEMBOLT_Vrkc}N
   Vrdc = Vrkc/γrcv                                   (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-1) 
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrkc}/${CHEMBOLT_γrcv}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrdc}N
   由于 Vgsd=${CHEMBOLT_FORCEV}N${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_CONCRETEVLESS)}Vrdc,所以混凝土楔形体破坏强度${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_CONCRETEVLESS)}满足要求

拉剪复合受力下植筋钢材破坏时的承载力,按照下面公式计算,
   (Nhsd/Nrds)^2 + (Vhsd/Vrds)^2 ≤ 1             (JGJ145-2004 6.3.1-1)
    Nrds = Nrks/γrsn                             (JGJ145-2004 6.3.1-2)
    Vrds = Vrks/γrsv                             (JGJ145-2004 6.3.1-3)
   Nhsd : 植筋群中拉力最大的植筋的拉力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}N  
   Nrds : 植筋钢材破坏受拉力设计值为${CHEMBOLT_Nrds}N 
   Vhsd : 植筋群中剪力最大的植筋的剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}N  
   Vrds : 植筋钢材破坏受剪承载力设计值
    (Nhsd/Nrds)^2 + (Vhsd/Vrds)^2
   =(${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}/${CHEMBOLT_Nrds})^2 + (${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}/${CHEMBOLT_Vrds})^2
   =${CHEMBOLT_COMPSTVALUE}${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_COMPSTLESS)}1
   所以植筋在拉剪复合受力下承载力${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_COMPSTLESS)}满足要求

1)混凝土基材厚度要求:
   hef+2×d0
  =${CHEMBOLT_HEF}+2×${CHEMBOLT_DH}
  =${CHEMBOLT_Hcheck}${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_HLESS)}h = ${CHEMBOLT_H}
  所以混凝土基材厚度${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_HLESS)}满足构造要求
  2)群锚最小间距值smin以及最小边距值cmin构造要求:
   5d=${Mul(5,CHEMBOLT_D)}mm${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_Scheck)}smin=${GetMin(CHEMBOLT_Layout[2][0],CHEMBOLT_Layout[2][1])}mm
   5d=${Mul(5,CHEMBOLT_D)}mm${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_Ccheck)}cmin=${GetMin(CHEMBOLT_C1,CHEMBOLT_C2)}mm
   所以群锚最小间距值smin${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_Scheck)}满足构造要求
       群锚最小边距值cmin${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_Ccheck)}满足构造要求
  3)胶筋界面破坏验算
    验算公式: Nrkpa = 7.7×hef×d×√fvk                          (JGJ145-2004 附录6.1.10(6))
    fvk: 锚固胶的钢-钢粘接抗剪强度标准值,当前选择建筑胶为${CHEMBOLT_GLUE},其值为${GetFvk(CHEMBOLT_GLUE)}N/mm^2
    Nrkpa = 7.7×hef×d×√fvk 
          = 7.7×${CHEMBOLT_HEF}×${CHEMBOLT_D}×√${GetFvk(CHEMBOLT_GLUE)} 
          = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpacal}N   ${CHEMBOLT_COPEN:*考虑未开裂混凝土受拉承载力提高系数ψcrn取1.67,得到
    Nrkpa =1.67×${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpacal} = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpa}}
    考虑分项系数1.1
    Nhsd=${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}N${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_GLUEGGLESS)}1.1×${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpa},所以锚固胶的钢-钢粘接抗剪强度${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_GLUEGGLESS)}满足要求
  4)沿胶层与混凝土界面破坏验算
    验算公式: Nrkpc = 1.7×hef×D×√fcuk                          (JGJ145-2004 附录6.1.10(8))
    Nrkpc = 1.7×hef×D×√fcuk    
          = 1.7×${CHEMBOLT_HEF}×${CHEMBOLT_DH}×√${GetFcuk(CHEMBOLT_CONLEVEL)} 
          = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpccal}N   ${CHEMBOLT_COPEN:*考虑未开裂混凝土受拉承载力提高系数ψcrn取2.44,得到
    Nrkpc =2.44×${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpccal} = ${CHEMBOLT_Nrkpc}}
    考虑承载力分项系数1.4有${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_GLUEGCLESS)}Nrkpc×1.1=${Mul(1.1,CHEMBOLT_Nrkpc)},所以锚固胶的胶-混粘接抗剪强度${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_GLUEGCLESS)}满足要求

单独考虑剪力作用,
   V :${CHEMBOLT_FORCEV}N
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('n','','y')}:参与V受剪的化学植筋数目为${CHEMBOLT_NY}个
   单个植筋承受的剪力为(x方向${GetEQSSubFormat('V','V','Sx')} = 0)
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','V','S')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(V,${GetSSubFormat('n','','y')})${GetEQFormat(1)}                                        (JGJ145-2004 5.3.2-2)
     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${CHEMBOLT_FORCEV},${CHEMBOLT_NY})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${CHEMBOLT_vs}N    ${IsNEqual(CHEMBOLT_FORCET,0.0):+ 
   考虑扭矩T = ${CHEMBOLT_FORCET}N.mm
   该计算数据通过表格给定,其中,ΔX,ΔY表示当前植筋相对于植筋群中心为原点的坐标.
   相关计算公式如下\:
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','T','Sx')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(T×y,∑x^2+∑y^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}                             (JGJ145-2004 5.3.3-1)
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','T','Sy')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(T×x,∑x^2+∑y^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}                             (JGJ145-2004 5.3.3-2)
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Smax')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r((${GetSSubFormat('V','V','Sx')} + ${GetSSubFormat('V','T','Sx')})^2+(${GetSSubFormat('V','V','S')} + ${GetSSubFormat('V','T','Sy')})^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}         (JGJ145-2004 5.3.4-1)
   通过计算得到∑x^2 = ${CHEMBOLT_TData[4]} , ∑y^2 = ${CHEMBOLT_TData[5]}

   ${CHEMBOLT_TABLE(0)} }

    ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Smax')} = ${CHEMBOLT_TData[3]}N ,${CHEMBOLT_TData[2]}号植筋剪力最大}${IsNEqual(CHEMBOLT_FORCET,0.0):* 
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Smax')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','V','S')}

   其中${GetEQSSubFormat('V','h','Sd')} : 植筋群中剪力最大的植筋的剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}N  
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rds')} : 植筋钢材破坏受剪承载力设计值

   ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','yk')} = ${GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}N/mm^2
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('γ','','RsV')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+1.3}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*1.2}×${GetSSubFormat('f','','stk')},${GetSSubFormat('f','','yk')})${GetEQFormat(1)} 
　　 　 = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:+1.3}${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*1.2}×${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)},${GetFyk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)})${GetEQFormat(1)}
　 　　 =${CHEMBOLT_γrsvcal}

        = 0.5×${CHEMBOLT_As}×${GetFstk(CHEMBOLT_STEELLEVEL)}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrks}N
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rds')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rks')},${GetSSubFormat('γ','','RsV')})${GetEQFormat(1)}
        = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${CHEMBOLT_Vrks},${CHEMBOLT_γrsv})${GetEQFormat(1)}

   由于 ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','h','Sd')}=${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}N${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_STEELVLESS)}${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rds')},所以植筋钢材${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_STEELVLESS)}满足抗剪强度要求
   2)构件边缘受剪混凝土楔形体破坏校核   
   c: 植筋到混凝土边距,取c1=${CHEMBOLT_C1}mm和c2=${CHEMBOLT_C2}mm的较小值为${GetMin(CHEMBOLT_C1,CHEMBOLT_C2)}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','ef')}:植筋有效锚固深度为${CHEMBOLT_HEF}mm

   校核依据 ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','g','Sd')} ≤ ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rdc')}                      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.1) 
   其中${GetEQSSubFormat('V','g','Sd')} : 植筋群总剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_FORCEV}N  
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rdc')} : 混凝土楔形体破坏时的受剪承载力设计值
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rdc')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rkc')},${GetSSubFormat('γ','','RcV')})${GetEQFormat(1)}                          (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-1) 
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rkc')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','0','Rkc')}× ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('A','','cV')},${GetSSubFormat('A','0','cV')})${GetEQFormat(1)} ×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','sV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','hV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','aV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ecV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucrV')}      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-2) 
   上式中
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rkc')} :构件边缘混凝土破坏时受剪承载力标准值
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('γ','','RcV')} :构件边缘混凝土破坏时受剪承载力分项系数,按4.2.6取用,对于对于${CHEMBOLT_STRUCT:*非}结构构件,取${CHEMBOLT_γrcv}
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','0','Rkc')}:开裂混凝土,单根锚筋垂直构件边缘受剪,混凝土理想破坏时的受剪承载力标准值
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','0','cV')} :单根锚筋受剪,混凝土破坏理想楔形体在侧向的投影面面积
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','cV')}  :群锚受剪,混凝土破坏理想楔形体在侧向的投影面面积

   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','hV')}  :边距与厚度比${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(c1,h)${GetEQFormat(1)}对受剪承载力的提高影响系数
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','aV')}  :剪力角度对受剪承载力的影响系数
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ecV')} :荷载偏心ev对群锚受剪承载力的降低影响系数
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucrV')}:未开裂混凝土及锚区配筋对受剪承载力的提高影响系数,当前为${CHEMBOLT_SIDECONTYPEDESC},取${CHEMBOLT_ψucrv}
   以下分别对各参数进行计算
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('d','','nom')} :植筋外径取${CHEMBOLT_D}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('l','','f')}   :剪切荷载作用下植筋的有效长度,给定值为${CHEMBOLT_LF}mm${IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_LF,Mul(8,CHEMBOLT_D)):+,按照规范要求${GetEQSSubFormat('l','','f')}≤8d,故取${GetEQSSubFormat('l','','f')}=8d=${Mul(8,CHEMBOLT_D)}mm}
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','cuk')} :混凝土立方体抗压强度标准值,当前级别${CHEMBOLT_CONLEVEL}
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','0','Rkc')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}0.45×\\r(${GetSSubFormat('d','','nom')}) × \\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('l','','f')},${GetSSubFormat('d','','nom')}))${GetSSubFormat('','0.2','')} × \\r(${GetSSubFormat('f','','cuk')}) ×c1^1.5${GetEQFormat(1)}            (JGJ145-2004 6.2.4) 
         = ${GetEQFormat(0)}0.45×\\r(${CHEMBOLT_D}) × \\b(\\f(${CHEMBOLT_TLF},${CHEMBOLT_D}))${GetSSubFormat('','0.2','')} × \\r(${GetFcuk(CHEMBOLT_CONLEVEL)}) ×${CHEMBOLT_C1}^1.5${GetEQFormat(1)}
         = ${CHEMBOLT_Vorkc}N
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','0','cV')} = 4.5×c1^2                                      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.5) 
        = 4.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1}^2
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Aocv}mm^2
   本处通常考虑四筋或以上作用,故
   s2 :垂直于剪力作用方向的外层植筋距离取${CHEMBOLT_S2}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','cV')} = (1.5×c1+s2+c2)×h                              (JGJ145-2004 6.2.6-3) 
       = (1.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1}+${CHEMBOLT_S2}+${CHEMBOLT_C2})×${CHEMBOLT_H}
       = ${CHEMBOLT_Acv}mm^2
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','sV')} = 0.7+ ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(0.3×c2,1.5×c1)${GetEQFormat(1)}                           (JGJ145-2004 6.2.7) 
       = 0.7+ ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(0.3×${CHEMBOLT_C2},1.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1})${GetEQFormat(1)}
       =${CHEMBOLT_ψsvcal}${IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_ψsvcal,1):+>1,按照规范取1}
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','hV')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(1.5×c1,h))\fs18\f17\\s((1/3), )${GetEQFormat(1)}                            (JGJ145-2004 6.2.8) 
       = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(1.5×${CHEMBOLT_C1},${CHEMBOLT_H}))\fs18\f17\\s((1/3), )${GetEQFormat(1)}
       = ${CHEMBOLT_ψhvcal}${IsLess(CHEMBOLT_ψhvcal,1):+<1,按照规范取1}
   由于剪力与垂直于构件自由边方向轴线的夹角为${CHEMBOLT_ANGLE}°,所以,按照规范JGJ145-2004 6.2.9有
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','aV')} = ${IsNLarge(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,55):+1.0}${IsNLess(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,90):+2.0}${Mul(IsLess(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,90),IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_ANGLE,55)):+${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1,cosα+0.5sinα)${GetEQFormat(1)}
       = ${CHEMBOLT_ψav}}
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('e','','V')} :剪力合力点到受剪锚筋重心的距离为${CHEMBOLT_EV}mm
   ψecv = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1,1 + \\f(2${GetSSubFormat('e','','V')},3c1))${GetEQFormat(1)}                               (JGJ145-2004 6.2.10) 
        = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1,1 + \\f(2×${CHEMBOLT_EV},3×${CHEMBOLT_C1}))${GetEQFormat(1)}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_ψecvcal}${IsLarge(CHEMBOLT_ψecvcal,1):+>1,按照规范取1}
   所以得到
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rkc')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','0','Rkc')}× ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('A','','cV')},${GetSSubFormat('A','0','cV')})${GetEQFormat(1)} ×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','sV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','hV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','aV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ecV')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucrV')}      (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-2) 
        =${CHEMBOLT_Vorkc}× ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${CHEMBOLT_Acv},${CHEMBOLT_Aocv})${GetEQFormat(1)} ×${CHEMBOLT_ψsv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψhv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψav}×${CHEMBOLT_ψecv}×${CHEMBOLT_ψucrv}
        =${CHEMBOLT_Vrkc}N
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rdc')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rkc')},${GetSSubFormat('γ','','RcV')})${GetEQFormat(1)}                                   (JGJ145-2004 6.2.3-1) 
        = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${CHEMBOLT_Vrkc},${CHEMBOLT_γrcv})${GetEQFormat(1)}
        = ${CHEMBOLT_Vrdc}N
   由于 ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','g','Sd')}=${CHEMBOLT_FORCEV}N${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_CONCRETEVLESS)}${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rdc')},所以混凝土楔形体破坏强度${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_CONCRETEVLESS)}满足要求

拉剪复合受力下植筋钢材破坏时的承载力,按照下面公式计算,
   ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','h','Sd')},${GetSSubFormat('N','','Rds')}))\fs18\f17\\s(2, ) + \\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','h','Sd')},${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rds')}))\fs18\f17\\s(2, )${GetEQFormat(1)} ≤ 1             (JGJ145-2004 6.3.1-1)
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','Rds')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','','Rks')},${GetSSubFormat('γ','','RsN')})${GetEQFormat(1)}                             (JGJ145-2004 6.3.1-2)
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rds')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rks')},${GetSSubFormat('γ','','RsV')})${GetEQFormat(1)}                             (JGJ145-2004 6.3.1-3)
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','h','Sd')} : 植筋群中拉力最大的植筋的拉力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_nhsd}N  
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','Rds')} : 植筋钢材破坏受拉力设计值为${CHEMBOLT_Nrds}N 
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','h','Sd')} : 植筋群中剪力最大的植筋的剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHEMBOLT_vhsd}N  
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','Rds')} : 植筋钢材破坏受剪承载力设计值
    ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','h','Sd')},${GetSSubFormat('N','','Rds')}))\fs18\f17\\s(2, ) + \\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','h','Sd')},${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rds')}))\fs18\f17\\s(2, )${GetEQFormat(1)}
   =${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${CHEMBOLT_nhsd},${CHEMBOLT_Nrds}))\fs18\f17\\s(2, ) + \\b(\\f(${CHEMBOLT_vhsd},${CHEMBOLT_Vrds}))\fs18\f17\\s(2, )${GetEQFormat(1)}
   =${CHEMBOLT_COMPSTVALUE}${GetLess(CHEMBOLT_COMPSTLESS)}1
   所以植筋在拉剪复合受力下承载力${GetOKStr(CHEMBOLT_COMPSTLESS)}满足要求

Es=E0×10^((a×t)/(b+t))           (JGJ/T151-2008   5.2.1)

e=f×Es       (JGJ/T 151-2008   5.2.2)

    f：空气的相对湿度，％；
    Es：空气的饱和水蒸汽压，hPa；

Td=b/(a/lg(e/6.11)-1)  [注：lg(e/6.11)表示取以10为底，e/6.11的对数。]   (JGJ/T 151-2008   5.2.3)
式中：

    e：空气的水蒸汽压，hPa；
    a、b：参数，a=7.5，b=237.3；

根据《建筑门窗玻璃幕墙热工计算规程》JGJ/T151-2008 5.3.6规定,产品的结露性能评价指标T10,min确定门窗、玻璃幕墙在实际工程中是否结露，应以内表面最低温度不低于室内露点温度为满足要求，可按下式计算判定：
    (T10,min - Tout,std)×(Tin-Tout)/(Tin,std - Tout,std) + Tout ≥ Td        (5.3.6)
    式中 
    T10,min: 产品的结露性能评价指标${DEW_TMIN}℃；
    Tin,std: 结露性能计算时对应的室内标准温度${DEW_TINSTD}℃；
    Tout,std: 结露性能计算时对应的室外标准温度${DEW_TOUTSTD}℃；
    Tin: 实际工程对应的室内计算温度${DEW_ITEMP}℃；
    Tout: 实际工程对应的室外计算温度${DEW_OTEMP}℃；
    Td : 室内设计环境条件对应的露点温度${DEW_Td}℃；
    Tpj = (T10,min - Tout,std)×(Tin-Tout)/(Tin,std - Tout,std) + Tout
        = (${DEW_TMIN} - ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_TOUTSTD}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)})×(${DEW_ITEMP} - ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_OTEMP}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)})/(${DEW_TINSTD} - ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_TOUTSTD}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)}) + ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_OTEMP}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)}
        = ${DEW_Tpj}℃
    因为Td=${DEW_Td}℃${GetLess(DEW_POINTLESS)}${DEW_Tpj}℃；
    幕墙${GetOKStr(IsEqual(DEW_POINTLESS,0))}会出现结露现象。

${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('E','','s')}=${GetSSubFormat('E','','0')}×10\fs18\f17\\s(\\b(\\f(a×t,b+t)), )${GetEQFormat(1)}    (JGJ/T151-2008   5.2.1)

${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('T','','d')}= \\f(b,\\f(a,lg(\\f(e,6.11))) - 1)${GetEQFormat(1)}    (JGJ/T 151-2008   5.2.3)

根据《建筑门窗玻璃幕墙热工计算规程》JGJ/T151-2008 5.3.6规定,产品的结露性能评价指标${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','10,min')}确定门窗、玻璃幕墙在实际工程中是否结露，应以内表面最低温度不低于室内露点温度为满足要求，可按下式计算判定：
    ${GetEQFormat(0)}(${GetSSubFormat('T','','10,min')} - ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out,std')}) × \\f(${GetSSubFormat('T','','in')} - ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out')}, ${GetSSubFormat('T','','in,std')} - ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out,std')}) + ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out')} ≥ ${GetSSubFormat('T','','d')}${GetEQFormat(1)}        (5.3.6)
    式中 
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','10,min')}: 产品的结露性能评价指标${DEW_TMIN}℃；
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','in,std')}: 结露性能计算时对应的室内标准温度${DEW_TINSTD}℃；
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','out,std')}: 结露性能计算时对应的室外标准温度${DEW_TOUTSTD}℃；
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','in')}: 实际工程对应的室内计算温度${DEW_ITEMP}℃；
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','out')}: 实际工程对应的室外计算温度${DEW_OTEMP}℃；
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','d')} : 室内设计环境条件对应的露点温度${DEW_Td}℃；
    ${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('T','','pj')} = (${GetSSubFormat('T','','10,min')} - ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out,std')}) × \\f(${GetSSubFormat('T','','in')} - ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out')}, ${GetSSubFormat('T','','in,std')} - ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out,std')}) + ${GetSSubFormat('T','','out')}${GetEQFormat(1)}
        ${GetEQFormat(0)}= (${DEW_TMIN} - ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_TOUTSTD}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)}) × \\f(${DEW_ITEMP} - ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_OTEMP}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)}, ${DEW_TINSTD} - ${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+(}${DEW_TOUTSTD}${IsLess(DEW_TOUTSTD,0):+)}) + ${DEW_OTEMP}${GetEQFormat(1)}
        = ${DEW_Tpj}℃
    因为${GetEQSSubFormat('T','','d')}=${DEW_Td}℃${GetLess(DEW_POINTLESS)}${DEW_Tpj}℃；

1).计算参数说明
   βf:正面角焊缝(端焊缝)的强度设计增大系数，对承受静力荷载和间接承受动力荷载的结构取1.22；对直接承受动力荷载的结构取1.0
   fwt:角焊缝的强度设计值取${GetFa(HFM)}N/mm^2  
   2).焊缝剪应力计算
   水平剪应力计算
   Afx : 水平方向承受剪力的焊缝面积
   Afx = Lx×hf×0.7
       = ${WNMV_LengthVX}×${WNMV_Hf}×0.7
       = ${WNMV_Afx}mm^2
   τx  = Vx/Afx
       = ${WNMV_VX}×1000/${WNMV_Afx}
       = ${WNMV_fvx}N/mm^2
   竖直剪应力计算
   Afy : 竖直方向承受剪力的焊缝面积
   Afy = Ly×hf×0.7
       = ${WNMV_LengthVY}×${WNMV_Hf}×0.7
       = ${WNMV_Afy}mm^2
   τy  = Vy/Afy
       = ${WNMV_VY}×1000/${WNMV_Afy}
       = ${WNMV_fvy}N/mm^2
   3).弯矩作用产生的正应力计算
   σwx= Mx/βf/Wy
      = ${WNMV_MX}×1000/${WNMV_belta}/${GetMin(WNMV_Wy1,WNMV_Wy2)}
      = ${WNMV_fmx}N/mm^2
   σwy= My/βf/Wx
      = ${WNMV_MY}×1000/${WNMV_belta}/${GetMin(WNMV_Wz1,WNMV_Wz2)}
      = ${WNMV_fmy}N/mm^2   
   4).组合应力计算
    在弯矩、剪力共同作用下焊缝的组合应力验算如下：
    σ = ((σwx+σwy)^2+(τx^2+τy^2))^0.5
      = ((${WNMV_fmx}+${WNMV_fmy})^2+(${WNMV_fvx}^2+${WNMV_fvy}^2))^0.5
      = ${WNMV_f}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(WNMV_Strength)}fwt=${GetFa(HFM)}N/mm^2
   所以，焊缝强度${GetOKStr(WNMV_Strength)}满足要求

  \i  Scrn=3×hef =${CHMBOLT_scrn}mm \i0
　\i　Acn0=Scrn^2 =${CHMBOLT_Acn0}mm^2  \i0
　　Acn：混凝土实际破坏锥体投影面积，按6.1.5[JGJ145-2013]取, 
其中：
    c1、c2、c3、c4：锚栓群距混凝土边的下、右、上、左边矩；
    s1、s2：竖直方向和水平方向锚栓最大的间距，分别为${CHMBOLT_SMT[0]}mm和${CHMBOLT_SMT[1]}mm；
    Ccrn：无间距效应和边缘效应情况下混凝土锥体破坏时的临界边矩，取Ccrn=${CHMBOLT_CcrnRatio}×hef=${CHMBOLT_Ccrn}mm
　　Acn=${CHMBOLT_Acn}mm^2
    具体示意图如下(受压锚栓不计入面积)：
    ${CHMBOLT_AcnDrawing}
　　ψsn：边矩c对受拉承载力的影响系数，按6.1.6[JGJ145-2013]采用：
   \i 　　ψsn=0.7+0.3×c/Ccrn≤1    \i0 (JGJ145-2013 6.1.6)
　　其中c为边矩，当为多个边矩时，取最小值，取为${CHMBOLT_C}mm
　\i　ψsn=0.7+0.3×c/Ccrn \i0
　\i　   =0.7+0.3×${CHMBOLT_C}/${CHMBOLT_Ccrn} \i0
　\i　   =${CHMBOLT_ψsncal}${IsLarge(CHMBOLT_ψsncal,1):+>1} \i0
　　所以，ψsn取${CHMBOLT_ψsn}。
　　ψren：表层混凝土因为密集配筋的剥离作用对受拉承载力的影响系数，按6.1.7[JGJ145-2013]采用，当锚固区钢筋间距s≥150mm或钢筋直径d≤10mm且s≥100mm时，取1.0；
    当前锚固区属于${IsEqual(CHMBOLT_AREINTYPE,0):+钢筋间距s≥150mm，取ψren=1.0}${IsEqual(CHMBOLT_AREINTYPE,1):+钢筋直径d≤10mm且s≥100mm，取ψren=1.0}${IsEqual(CHMBOLT_AREINTYPE,2):+其它类型,需要按照下式计算
　\i　ψren=0.5+hef/200≤1 \i0
 　\i　    =${CHMBOLT_ψrencal}${IsLarge(CHMBOLT_ψrencal,1):+>1,取1.0}} \i0
　　ψecn：荷载偏心eN对受拉承载力的影响系数，按6.1.8[JGJ145-2013]采用；
  \i  ψecn=ψecn1×ψecn2 ≤1 \i0
  \i       =(1/(1+2eNx/Scrn))×(1/(1+2eNy/Scrn)) \i0
  \i       =(1/(1+2×${CHMBOLT_eNx}/${CHMBOLT_scrn}))×(1/(1+2×${CHMBOLT_eNy}/${CHMBOLT_scrn})) \i0
  \i       =${CHMBOLT_ψecncal}${IsLarge(CHMBOLT_ψecncal,1):+>1} \i0
    所以，ψecn取${CHMBOLT_ψecn}。
　　把上面所得到的各项代入，得：
　\i　Nrkc=Nrkc0×Acn/Acn0×ψsn×ψren×ψecn \i0
　\i　    =${CHMBOLT_Nrkc0}×${CHMBOLT_Acn}/${CHMBOLT_Acn0}×${CHMBOLT_ψsn}×${CHMBOLT_ψren}×${CHMBOLT_ψecn} \i0
　\i　    =${CHMBOLT_Nrkc}N \i0
 \i   Nrdc=${CHMBOLT_HASEARTHQUAKE:+k×}Nrkc/γrcn \i0
　\i　    =${CHMBOLT_HASEARTHQUAKE:+${CHMBOLT_nk}×}${CHMBOLT_Nrkc}/${CHMBOLT_γrcn} \i0
 \i       =${CHMBOLT_Nrdc}N    \i0
   由于 γ0×Ngsd=${Mul(CHMBOLT_Ngsd,CHMBOLT_γ0)}${GetLess(CHMBOLT_CONEPULLLESS)}Nrdc,所以群锚混凝土锥体受拉破坏承载力${GetOKStr(CHMBOLT_CONEPULLLESS)}满足设计要求！

   其中${GetEQSSubFormat('V','h','Sd')} : 锚栓群中剪力最大的锚栓的剪力设计值,根据上面计算取${CHMBOLT_vhsd}N

    \i     = ${CHMBOLT_Vorkc}N \i0
  \i Aocv = 4.5×cx1^2            \i0                           (JGJ145-2013 6.1.17)

  \i      = ${CHMBOLT_Aocv}mm^2 \i0
   本处通常考虑群锚作用,故
   ${CHMBOLT_AcvDrawing}
 \i  Acv = ${CHMBOLT_Acv}mm^2 \i0
  \i ψsv = 0.7+0.3×cx2/(1.5×cx1)     \i0                       (JGJ145-2013 6.1.19)

 \i  ψhv = (1.5×cx1/h)^(1/2)          \i0                   (JGJ145-2013 6.1.20)

  \i      =${CHMBOLT_Vrkc}N \i0
 \i  Vrdc = ${CHMBOLT_HASEARTHQUAKE:+k×}Vrkc/γrcv     \i0                               (JGJ145-2013 6.2.18-1)  
  \i      = ${CHMBOLT_HASEARTHQUAKE:+${CHMBOLT_VK}×}${CHMBOLT_Vrkc}/${CHMBOLT_γrcv} \i0
  \i      = ${CHMBOLT_Vrdc}N \i0

1).计算参数说明
   βf:正面角焊缝(端焊缝)的强度设计增大系数，对承受静力荷载和间接承受动力荷载的结构取${LPWELD_belta}；对直接承受动力荷载的结构取1.0
   fwt:角焊缝的强度设计值取${GetFa(LPWELD_HFM)}N/mm^2  
   2).焊缝剪应力计算
   水平剪应力计算
   Afx : 水平方向承受剪力的焊缝面积
   Afx = Lx×hf×0.7
       = ${LPWELD_LengthVX}×${LPWELD_Hf}×0.7
       = ${LPWELD_Afx}mm^2
   τx  = Vx/Afx
       = ${LPWELD_VX}×1000/${LPWELD_Afx}
       = ${LPWELD_fvx}N/mm^2
   竖直剪应力计算
   Afy : 竖直方向承受剪力的焊缝面积
   Afy = Ly×hf×0.7
       = ${LPWELD_LengthVY}×${LPWELD_Hf}×0.7
       = ${LPWELD_Afy}mm^2
   τy  = Vy/Afy
       = ${LPWELD_VY}×1000/${LPWELD_Afy}
       = ${LPWELD_fvy}N/mm^2  ${IsLarge(LPWELD_N,0):+
   直接作用力产生的正应力计算
   σn = N/βf/A
       = ${LPWELD_N}×10/(${LPWELD_belta}×${LPWELD_Area})
       = ${LPWELD_n}N/mm^2 } 
   3).弯矩作用产生的正应力计算
   σwy= My/βf/Wy
      = ${LPWELD_MX}×1000/(${LPWELD_belta}×${GetMin(LPWELD_Wy1,LPWELD_Wy2)})
      = ${LPWELD_fmx}N/mm^2
   σwx= Mx/βf/Wx
      = ${LPWELD_MY}×1000/(${LPWELD_belta}×${GetMin(LPWELD_Wz1,LPWELD_Wz2)})
      = ${LPWELD_fmy}N/mm^2   
   4).组合应力计算
    在弯矩、剪力、轴力共同作用下焊缝的组合应力验算如下：
    σ = ((σwy+σwx${IsLarge(LPWELD_N,0):++σn})^2+(τx^2+τy^2))^0.5
       = ((${LPWELD_fmx}+${LPWELD_fmy}${IsLarge(LPWELD_N,0):++${LPWELD_n}})^2+(${LPWELD_fvx}^2+${LPWELD_fvy}^2))^0.5
       = ${LPWELD_f}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(LPWELD_Strength)}fwt=${GetFa(LPWELD_HFM)}N/mm^2
   所以，焊缝强度${GetOKStr(LPWELD_Strength)}满足要求

   4)直接作用力产生的构件端部正应力计算
   σn = N/A
       = ${LINKPOLE_N}×10/${LINKPOLE_Area}
       = ${LINKPOLE_fn}N/mm^2 
   5).弯矩作用产生的构件端部正应力计算
   σwh= Mh/γWy
      = ${LINKPOLE_ALLMX}×1000/${GetMin(LINKPOLE_Wy1,LINKPOLE_Wy2)}/${GetGama(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL)}
      = ${LINKPOLE_fmx}N/mm^2
   σwv= Mv/γWx
      = ${LINKPOLE_ALLMY}×1000/${GetMin(LINKPOLE_Wz1,LINKPOLE_Wz2)}/${GetGama(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL)}
      = ${LINKPOLE_fmy}N/mm^2   
   6).组合应力计算
    在弯矩、剪力、轴力共同作用下构件的复合应力验算如下：
    σ = ((σwh+σwv+σn)^2+(τx+τy)^2)^0.5
      = ((${LINKPOLE_fmx}+${LINKPOLE_fmy}+${LINKPOLE_fn})^2+(${LINKPOLE_fvx}+${LINKPOLE_fvy})^2)^0.5
      = ${LINKPOLE_f}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(LINKPOLE_StrengthOK)}fa=${GetFa(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL,LINKPOLE_t)}N/mm^2
    所以构件强度${GetOKStr(LINKPOLE_StrengthOK)}满足要求
   7).挠度计算
    在水平剪力作用下的挠度为
    Dvx = Vx×Lx^2×(3×L-Lx)/(6×E×Iy)
       = ${LINKPOLE_VX}×${LINKPOLE_LengthVX}^2×(3×${LINKPOLE_Length}-${LINKPOLE_LengthVX})×10^8/(6×${GetE(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL)}×${LINKPOLE_Iy})
       = ${LINKPOLE_Dvx}mm
    竖直剪力作用下的挠度为
    Dvy = Vy×Ly^2×(3×L-Ly)/(6×E×Ix)
       = ${LINKPOLE_VY}×${LINKPOLE_LengthVY}^2×(3×${LINKPOLE_Length}-${LINKPOLE_LengthVY})×10^8/(6×${GetE(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL)}×${LINKPOLE_Iz})
       = ${LINKPOLE_Dvy}mm  ${LOr(IsLarge(LINKPOLE_MX,0),IsLarge(LINKPOLE_MY,0)):+
    预加弯矩产生的挠度为 ${IsLarge(LINKPOLE_MX,0):+
    Dmx = Mxt×L^2/(2×E×Iy)
        = ${LINKPOLE_MX}×${LINKPOLE_Length}^2×10^8/(2×${GetE(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL)}×${LINKPOLE_Iy}) 
        = ${LINKPOLE_Dmx}mm }${IsLarge(LINKPOLE_MY,0):+
    Dmy = Myt×L^2/(2×E×Ix)
        = ${LINKPOLE_MY}×${LINKPOLE_Length}^2×10^8/(2×${GetE(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL)}×${LINKPOLE_Iz}) 
        = ${LINKPOLE_Dmy}mm } } 
    所以总的挠度为
    Dx = Dvx${IsLarge(LINKPOLE_MX,0):+ + Dmx}
       = ${LINKPOLE_Dx}mm
    Dy = Dvy${IsLarge(LINKPOLE_MY,0):+ + Dmy}
       = ${LINKPOLE_Dy}mm
    D  = (Dx^2 + Dy^2)^0.5
       = ${LINKPOLE_D}mm ${GetLess(LINKPOLE_DispOK)} 最大允许挠度Dfmax=L/${GetDfnum(LINKPOLE_MATERIAL,GLOB_WALLTYPE)}×2000=${LINKPOLE_dfmax}mm
    所以挠度${GetOKStr(LINKPOLE_DispOK)}满足要求

建筑围护结构构件的隔声，单指质量定律下空气声的隔绝。声音通过围护结构的传播，按传播规律有两种途径，一种是振动直接撞击围护结构，并使其成为声源，通过维护结构的构件作为媒介介质使振动沿固体构件传播，称为固体传声、撞击声或结构声；另一种是空气中的声源发声以后激发周围的空气振动，以空气为媒质，形成声波，传播至构件并激发构件振动，使小部分声音等透射传播到另一个空间，此种传播方式也叫空气传声或空气声。门窗、幕墙等结构工程，需要计算的是空气声隔声。
    声音在通过隔声材料时产生的能量损失，称为透射损失。其大小用透射系数来衡量，透射系数的定义是透射声能Et与入射声能Ei之比，如下公式:
    τ = Et/Ei
    一般门、窗和墙体的透射系数值在10^(-1)~10^(-5)之间，数值越小，表示所透射过去的声能越少，隔声性能就越好。透射系数数值很小，使用起来很不方便，为此，通常用隔声量来衡量一种材料或结构的隔声性能，隔声量的定义如下
    R = 10lg(1/τ)
    隔声量的实际意义就是隔声材料或结构两侧声压级的差值。与透射系数相反，材料或构造的隔声量越大，其隔声性能越好。
  1)单层匀质墙隔声量的经验公式如下：
    R = 16lgm + 14lgf - 29
    式中 R---墙体、楼板的空气隔声量(dB)；
         m---墙体、楼板的单位面积的质量(kg/m^2)；
         f---频率(Hz)；
    由上式看出，面密度增加一倍，隔声量提高5dB，平均的倍频程提高斜率为4dB左右，这就是“质量定律”。
    对100~3150Hz覆盖频率范围内的平均隔声量的经验公式如下：
    当m > 200kg/m^2时： R=16lgm + 8 
    当m < 200kg/m^2时： R=13.5lgm + 13;
  2)双层墙隔声量的经验公式如下：
    R = 16lg(m1+m2)×f - 30 + ΔR
    式中 R---双层墙隔声量(dB)；
     m1,m2---分别为两层的面密度(kg/m^2);
         f---频率(Hz)；
       ΔR---加设空气层后附加的隔声量，它根据空气层的厚度而不同。附加隔声量近似等于空气层厚度的0.1。
      对于PVB膜，当膜厚为0.38时ΔR取4dB；
        当膜厚为0.76时ΔR取5.5dB；
        当膜厚为1.14时ΔR取6dB；
        当膜厚为1.52时ΔR取7dB；
    平均隔声量的经验计算式如下：
    当(m1+m2) > 200kg/m^2时：
    R = 16lg(m1+m2) + 8 + ΔR
    当(m1+m2) < 200kg/m^2时：
    R = 13.5lg(m1+m2) + 13 + ΔR

当墙上有门窗时，因门窗的隔声量比墙低，因此整体隔声量下降。组合墙体隔声量与墙和门的隔声量、面积有关。一般来讲，墙比门的隔声量最多高10dB为好，墙体隔声量再高，由于门的影响，组合隔声量也不会提高。计算组合隔声量的公式是：
    τ=(τw×Sw + τd×Sd)/(Sw + Sd) 
    其中τ是组合墙体的透射系数
        τw是墙体的透射系数
        τd是门窗的透射系数
        Sw是墙体的面积
        Sd是门窗的面积
    透射系数与隔声量R的关系是τ=10^(-R/10)
    按照上面计算公式有
    τw = 10^(-Rw/10)
        = ${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_WANOISE)}
    τd = 10^(-Rd/10)
        = ${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_GANOISE)}
     Sw = ${ANTINOISE_WALLAREA}m^2
     Sd = ${ANTINOISE_GLASSAREA}m^2
    所以可以得到
    τ = (τw×Sw + τd×Sd)/(Sw + Sd) 
       = (${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_WANOISE)}×${ANTINOISE_WALLAREA} + ${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_GANOISE)}×${ANTINOISE_GLASSAREA})/(${ANTINOISE_WALLAREA} + ${ANTINOISE_GLASSAREA})
       = ${ANTINOISE_CT}
     R = 10×lg(1/τ)
       = ${ANTINOISE_CANOISE}dB
     所以组合墙体的隔声量为${ANTINOISE_CANOISE}dB

当墙上有门窗时，因门窗的隔声量比墙低，因此整体隔声量下降。组合墙体隔声量与墙和门的隔声量、面积有关。一般来讲，墙比门的隔声量最多高10dB为好，墙体隔声量再高，由于门的影响，组合隔声量也不会提高。计算组合隔声量的公式是：
    τ = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('τ','','w')}×${GetSSubFormat('S','','w')} + ${GetSSubFormat('τ','','d')}×${GetSSubFormat('S','','d')},${GetSSubFormat('S','','w')} + ${GetSSubFormat('S','','d')})${GetEQFormat(1)} 
    其中τ是组合墙体的透射系数
        ${GetEQSSubFormat('τ','','w')}是墙体的透射系数
        ${GetEQSSubFormat('τ','','d')}是门窗的透射系数
        ${GetEQSSubFormat('S','','w')}是墙体的面积
        ${GetEQSSubFormat('S','','d')}是门窗的面积
    透射系数与隔声量R的关系是τ=10^(- ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(R,10)${GetEQFormat(1)})
    按照上面计算公式有
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('τ','','w')} = 10^(- ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(Rw,10)${GetEQFormat(1)})
        = ${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_WANOISE)}
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('τ','','d')} = 10^(- ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(Rd,10)${GetEQFormat(1)})
        = ${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_GANOISE)}
     ${GetEQSSubFormat('S','','w')} = ${ANTINOISE_WALLAREA}m^2
     ${GetEQSSubFormat('S','','d')} = ${ANTINOISE_GLASSAREA}m^2
    所以可以得到
    τ = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('τ','','w')}×${GetSSubFormat('S','','w')} + ${GetSSubFormat('τ','','d')}×${GetSSubFormat('S','','d')},${GetSSubFormat('S','','w')} + ${GetSSubFormat('S','','d')})${GetEQFormat(1)} 
       = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_WANOISE)}×${ANTINOISE_WALLAREA} + ${GetTFromDB(ANTINOISE_GANOISE)}×${ANTINOISE_GLASSAREA},${ANTINOISE_WALLAREA} + ${ANTINOISE_GLASSAREA})${GetEQFormat(1)}
       = ${ANTINOISE_CT}
     R = 10×lg(${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1,τ)${GetEQFormat(1)})
       = ${ANTINOISE_CANOISE}dB
     所以组合墙体的隔声量为${ANTINOISE_CANOISE}dB

玻璃托板采用材料为${HOLDBLOCK_MATERIAL},托板厚度为${HOLDBLOCK_T},托板宽度为${HOLDBLOCK_W},计算的玻璃下部有${HOLDBLOCK_N}个托板,玻璃板块传递的重力设计值为${HOLDBLOCK_G}kN,托板上重力作用点距离托板边部距离为${HOLDBLOCK_L}mm,托板水平边总长度${HOLDBLOCK_L0}mm,托板竖向边总高为${HOLDBLOCK_H0}mm${HOLDBLOCK_HasLinkMD:+,连接铆钉材料级别为${HOLDBLOCK_MDMATERIAL},铆钉直径${HOLDBLOCK_Dm}mm,每个托板上连接铆钉数量为${HOLDBLOCK_Nm}个}。托板具体见下示意图
    ${HOLDBLOCK_DRAW}

作用在每个托块上的P = G/N = ${HOLDBLOCK_G}/${HOLDBLOCK_N} = ${HOLDBLOCK_P}kN
   托块与主型材接触角部的截面抵抗矩为
   Wx = ${HOLDBLOCK_W}×${HOLDBLOCK_T}^2/6
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_Wx}mm^3
   玻璃重力作用产生的弯矩为
   M = P × L
     = ${HOLDBLOCK_P}×1000×${HOLDBLOCK_L}
     = ${HOLDBLOCK_Moment}N.mm
   所以由于弯矩作用产生的正应力
   σ = M/Wx
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_Moment}/${HOLDBLOCK_Wx}
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_stress}N/mm^2
   由重力作用产生的剪应力
   τ = P/A
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_P}×1000/(${HOLDBLOCK_W}×${HOLDBLOCK_T})
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_tstress}N/mm^2
   考虑复合应力
    ((σ/[σ])^2 + (τ/[τ])^2)^(1/2)
       = ((${HOLDBLOCK_stress}/${HOLDBLOCK_Fa})^2 + (${HOLDBLOCK_tstress}/${HOLDBLOCK_Ft})^2)^(1/2)
       = ${HOLDBLOCK_strength} ${GetLess(HOLDBLOCK_STRENGTHOK)} 1 
   托板复合强度${GetOKStr(HOLDBLOCK_STRENGTHOK)}满足要求

托板在玻璃板块重力作用下,通过铆钉连接到主型材上,在铆钉连接处会产生局部压应力作用。
    铆钉数量为Nm=${HOLDBLOCK_Nm}
    铆钉与托板连接接触面按照下面计算考虑，单个铆钉接触面面积为
    Am = Dm×t
       = ${HOLDBLOCK_Dm}×${HOLDBLOCK_T}
       = ${HOLDBLOCK_AREAfp}mm^2
    σp= P/(Nm×Am)
       = ${HOLDBLOCK_P}×1000/(${HOLDBLOCK_Nm}×${HOLDBLOCK_AREAfp})
       = ${HOLDBLOCK_fpstress}N/mm^2
    由于 σp${GetLess(HOLDBLOCK_FPSTRENGTHOK)}${GetFp(HOLDBLOCK_MATERIAL,HOLDBLOCK_T)}N/mm^2,托板局部抗压强度${GetOKStr(HOLDBLOCK_FPSTRENGTHOK)}满足要求

铆钉连接处距离托板底部为H=${HOLDBLOCK_H}mm
    由于重力作用,托板竖向边对铆钉产生拉拔作用力,故需要验算铆钉的抗拉强度。
    由上面计算得到重力作用产生的以托板角部为支点的弯矩为M = ${HOLDBLOCK_Moment}N.mm
    每个铆钉上承受的拉拔力 F = M/H/Nm = ${HOLDBLOCK_Moment}/${HOLDBLOCK_Hex}/${HOLDBLOCK_Nm} = ${HOLDBLOCK_MDPForce}N
    由于 F ${GetLess(HOLDBLOCK_MDSTRENGTHOK)}${GetFa(HOLDBLOCK_MDMATERIAL,HOLDBLOCK_Dm)}N,铆钉抗拉强度${GetOKStr(HOLDBLOCK_MDSTRENGTHOK)}满足要求

铆钉连接处距离托板底部为H=${HOLDBLOCK_H}mm
    由于重力作用,托板竖向边对铆钉产生拉拔作用力,故需要验算铆钉的抗拉强度。
    由上面计算得到重力作用产生的以托板角部为支点的弯矩为M = ${HOLDBLOCK_Moment}N.mm
    每个铆钉上承受的拉拔力 F = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(M,H×${GetSSubFormat('N','','m')})${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${HOLDBLOCK_Moment},${HOLDBLOCK_Hex}×${HOLDBLOCK_Nm})${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${HOLDBLOCK_MDPForce}N
    由于 F ${GetLess(HOLDBLOCK_MDSTRENGTHOK)}${GetFa(HOLDBLOCK_MDMATERIAL,HOLDBLOCK_Dm)}N,铆钉抗拉强度${GetOKStr(HOLDBLOCK_MDSTRENGTHOK)}满足要求

由于重力作用,铆钉同时还承受剪力作用。
    V = P / Nm
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_P}×1000/${HOLDBLOCK_Nm}
      = ${HOLDBLOCK_MDshear}N      
    由于 V ${GetLess(HOLDBLOCK_MDSHEAROK)}${GetFt(HOLDBLOCK_MDMATERIAL,HOLDBLOCK_Dm)}N,铆钉抗剪强度${GetOKStr(HOLDBLOCK_MDSHEAROK)}满足要求

校核依据: τwp ≤  ${GetFt(STONE_SLOTMATERIAL,STONE_SLOTTHICK)}N/mm^2
   G: 面板板块重力方向设计值
   G = γG×GAK×B×H
     = ${STONE_SLOTWG}kN 
   Tp: 挂件截面厚度为${STONE_SLOTTHICK}mm
   Bp: 挂件截面宽度为${STONE_SLOTWIDTH}mm

   Ip = Bp×Tp^3/12
      = ${STONE_SLOTSecIx}mm^4

   Sp = (Bp×Tp/2)×Tp/4
      = ${STONE_SLOTSecSs}mm^3

   Wp = Bp×Tp^2/6
      = ${STONE_SLOTSecW}mm^3
   所以挂件在重力作用下产生的剪应力如下:
   τwp = G/n×Sp/(Ip×Bp)

校核依据: ${GetEQSSubFormat('τ','','wp')} ≤  ${GetFt(STONE_SLOTMATERIAL,STONE_SLOTTHICK)}N/mm^2
   G: 面板重力方向设计值
   G = ${GetEQSSubFormat('γ','','G')}×GAK×B×H
     = ${STONE_SLOTWG}kN

根据《铝合金门窗工程技术规范》JGJ214-2010 4.5要求,铝合金门窗水密性能设计指标即门窗不发生雨水渗漏的最高风压力差值(△P)应根据建筑物所在地的气象观测数据和建筑设计要求来确定。${IsEqual(WATERTIGHT_METEDATA,1):+当前地区气象资料显示，建筑物所需设防的降雨强度时的风力等级为${WATERTIGHT_WLEVEL}级，按照风力等级与风速的对应关系（4.5.1 表1）确定水密性能设计用风速V0(10min平均风速)为${WATERTIGHT_WINDSPEEDCALC}m/s。}${IsEqual(WATERTIGHT_METEDATA,2):+根据当前地区气象资料直接给定水密性能设计用风速V0(10min平均风速)为${WATERTIGHT_AWSPEED}m/s。}${WATERTIGHT_METEDATA:+
    铝合金门窗水密性能设计指标△P应按下式计算\:
    △P = 0.9×ρ×μz×V0^2                  ( JGJ214-2010 4.5.1)
    式中\: △P --- 任意高度z处门窗的瞬时风速风压力差值(Pa)；
           ρ --- 空气密度(t/m^3),按现行国家标准${GLOB_LC_GD:*《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2012}${GLOB_LC_GD:+《广东省建筑结构荷载规范》DBJ 15-101-2022}的规定进行计算；
          μz --- 风压高度变化系数，按现行国家标准${GLOB_LC_GD:*《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2012}${GLOB_LC_GD:+《广东省建筑结构荷载规范》DBJ 15-101-2022}的规定进行计算；
           V0 --- 水密性能设计用10min平均风速(m/s)。   
    z \: 计算高度${WATERTIGHT_ELEVATION}m  
   ρ = 0.00125e^(-0.0001z)
      = 0.00125e^(-0.0001×${WATERTIGHT_ELEVATION})
      = ${WATERTIGHT_MIDU}t/m^3    
   μz\: ${WATERTIGHT_ELEVATION}m高处风压高度变化系数(按${REGION}类区计算)\:    ${GLOB_LC_GD:*(GB50009-2012  条文说明8.2.1)}
       μz=${μh}×(z/10)^${α2}=${WATERTIGHT_μzcal} ${IsLess(WATERTIGHT_μzcal,WATERTIGHT_μz):+由于${WATERTIGHT_μzcal}<${WATERTIGHT_μz},取μz=${WATERTIGHT_μz}}
   所以有
    △P = 0.9×ρ×μz×V0^2
        = 0.9×${WATERTIGHT_MIDU}×${WATERTIGHT_μz}×${WATERTIGHT_WINDSPEED}^2×1000
        = ${WATERTIGHT_DELTAP}Pa } ${WATERTIGHT_METEDATA:*
   在没有气象资料可用的情况下，铝合金门窗水密性能设计指标△P可用下式计算\:
   △P ≥ C×μz×ω0                         ( JGJ214-2010 4.5.2)
  式中\: △P --- 任意高度z处门窗的瞬时风速风压力差值(Pa)；
          C --- 水密性能设计计算系数\:对于热带风暴和台风地区取值为0.5，其他非热带风暴和台风地区取值为0.4；
        μz --- 风压高度变化系数，按现行国家标准${GLOB_LC_GD:*《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2012}${GLOB_LC_GD:+《广东省建筑结构荷载规范》DBJ 15-101-2022}的规定进行计算；
        ω0 --- 基本风压(Pa)；${CITYNAME}地区基本风压，取${Mul(1000,ω0)}Pa 
    μz\: ${WATERTIGHT_ELEVATION}m高处风压高度变化系数(按${REGION}类区计算)\:    ${GLOB_LC_GD:*(GB50009-2012  条文说明8.2.1)}
       μz=${μh}×(z/10)^${α2}=${WATERTIGHT_μzcal} ${IsLess(WATERTIGHT_μzcal,WATERTIGHT_μz):+由于${WATERTIGHT_μzcal}<${WATERTIGHT_μz},取μz=${WATERTIGHT_μz}}
  所以有：
   △P ≥ C×μz×ω0                 ( JGJ214-2010 4.5.2)

有效惯性矩计算公式为:
   Ief = Is×(1-ν)/(1- ν×C）                  （1)
   其中: Is = I1+ I2 + A1×a1^2 +A2×a2^2           （2）
         ν = (A1×a1^2 +A2×a2^2)/Is               （3）
          C = λ^2/（π^2+λ^2）                     （4)
        λ^2= c×a^2×L^2/(E×Is×ν×(1-ν))        （5)
   式中:     Ief  — 有效惯性矩(单位为cm^4)；
              Is   —  刚性惯性矩(单位为cm^4)；
              ν   —  刚性惯性矩的组合参数；
               C   —  弹性结合作用参数；
               λ  —  几何形状参数；
               L   —  梁的跨度(单位为cm)；
               c   —  组合弹性值(单位为N/mm^2)；
               E   —  组合弹性模量(单位为N/mm^2)；
               A1  —  上部铝材的截面积(单位为cm^2)；
               A2  —  下部铝材的截面积(单位为cm^2)；
               a1  —  上部铝材形心到隔热型材形心的距离(单位为cm)；
               a2  —  下部铝材形心到隔热型材形心的距离(单位为cm)；
               I1  —  上部铝材型材惯性矩(单位为cm^4)；
               I2  —  下部铝材型材惯性矩(单位为cm^4)。
   按照上面公式计算有
   Is = I1+ I2 + A1×a1^2 +A2×a2^2
      = ${INSUPROP_UPIz} + ${INSUPROP_DOWNIz} + ${INSUPROP_UPArea}×${INSUPROP_DistA1}^2 + ${INSUPROP_DOWNArea}×${INSUPROP_DistA2}^2
      = ${INSUPROP_Is}cm^4
   ν = (A1×a1^2 +A2×a2^2)/Is 
      = (${INSUPROP_UPArea}×${INSUPROP_DistA1}^2 + ${INSUPROP_DOWNArea}×${INSUPROP_DistA2}^2)/${INSUPROP_Is}
      = ${INSUPROP_V}
   λ^2= c×a^2×L^2/(E×Is×ν×(1-ν))
       =${INSUPROP_INSUPARAMC}×${INSUPROP_DistA}^2×${Mul(INSUPROP_INSULENGTH,100)}^2/(${INSUPROP_INSUPARAME}×${INSUPROP_Is}×${INSUPROP_V}×(1-${INSUPROP_V}))
       =${INSUPROP_LAMBDA}
    C = λ^2/（π^2+λ^2）
      = ${INSUPROP_LAMBDA}/(π^2+${INSUPROP_LAMBDA})
      = ${INSUPROP_C}
    Ief = Is×(1-ν)/(1- ν×C）
        = ${INSUPROP_Is}×(1-${INSUPROP_V})/(1-${INSUPROP_V}×${INSUPROP_C}）
        = ${INSUPROP_Izc}cm^4
   所以得到该隔热型材的截面特性如下:
   X轴惯性矩: Ix=${INSUPROP_Iz}cm^4
   Y轴惯性矩: Iy=${INSUPROP_Iy}cm^4
   X轴上部抵抗矩: Wx1=${INSUPROP_Wz1}cm^3
   X轴下部抵抗矩: Wx2=${INSUPROP_Wz2}cm^3
   Y轴左部抵抗矩: Wy1=${INSUPROP_Wy1}cm^3
   Y轴右部抵抗矩: Wy2=${INSUPROP_Wy2}cm^3
   型材计算校核处抗剪壁厚: t=${INSUPROP_t}mm
   型材截面积: A=${INSUPROP_Area}cm^2
   型材截面面积矩: Ss=${INSUPROP_Sz}cm^3 ${INSUPROP_PROID:+
   ${XDrawProfileEX(INSUPROP_PROID,INSUPROP_SLD,INSUPROP_PRODESC)}}

   其中：${GetEQSSubFormat('I','','s')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('I','','1')}+ ${GetEQSSubFormat('I','','2')} + ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','1')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('a','','1')}^2 +${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','2')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('a','','2')}^2      （2）

        λ^2= ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(c×a^2×L^2,E×${GetSSubFormat('I','','s')}×ν×(1-ν))${GetEQFormat(1)}              （5)
   式中：     ${GetEQSSubFormat('I','','ef')}  — 有效惯性矩(单位为cm^4)；

      = ${INSUPROP_Is}cm^4
   ν = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('A','','1')}×${GetSSubFormat('a','','1')}^2 +${GetSSubFormat('A','','2')}×${GetSSubFormat('a','','2')}^2,${GetSSubFormat('I','','s')})${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${INSUPROP_UPArea}×${INSUPROP_DistA1}^2 + ${INSUPROP_DOWNArea}×${INSUPROP_DistA2}^2,${INSUPROP_Is})${GetEQFormat(1)}

   λ^2= ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(c×a^2×L^2,E×${GetSSubFormat('I','','s')}×ν×(1-ν))${GetEQFormat(1)}
       =${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${INSUPROP_INSUPARAMC}×${INSUPROP_DistA}^2×${Mul(INSUPROP_INSULENGTH,100)}^2,${INSUPROP_INSUPARAME}×${INSUPROP_Is}×${INSUPROP_V}×(1-${INSUPROP_V}))${GetEQFormat(1)}
       =${INSUPROP_LAMBDA}
    C = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(λ^2,π^2+λ^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${INSUPROP_LAMBDA},π^2+${INSUPROP_LAMBDA})${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${INSUPROP_C}
    ${GetEQSSubFormat('I','','ef')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('I','','s')}×${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1-ν,1- ν×C)${GetEQFormat(1)}
        = ${INSUPROP_Is}×${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1-${INSUPROP_V},1-${INSUPROP_V}×${INSUPROP_C})${GetEQFormat(1)}
        = ${INSUPROP_Izc}cm^4

(1).场地类别划分: 
   根据地面粗糙度,场地可划分为以下类别:
   A类近海面,海岛,海岸,湖岸及沙漠地区;
   B类指田野,乡村,丛林,丘陵以及房屋比较稀疏的乡镇和城市郊区;
   C类指有密集建筑群的城市市区;
   D类指有密集建筑群且房屋较高的城市市区;
   ${PROJECTNAME}按${REGION}类地区计算风压
(2).风荷载计算:
   幕墙属于薄壁外围护构件，根据《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2001(2006年版) 7.1.1-2 采用
   风荷载计算公式: Wk=βgz×μz×μsl×W0
   其中: Wk---作用在幕墙上的风荷载标准值(kN/m^2)
        βgz---瞬时风压的阵风系数,按《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2001(2006年版)取定
              根据不同场地类型,按以下公式计算:βgz=K(1+2μf)
              其中K为地区粗糙度调整系数，μf为脉动系数
              A类场地: βgz=0.92×(1+2μf)  其中：μf=0.387×(Z/10)^(-0.12)
              B类场地: βgz=0.89×(1+2μf)  其中：μf=0.5×(Z/10)^(-0.16)
              C类场地: βgz=0.85×(1+2μf)  其中：μf=0.734×(Z/10)^(-0.22)
              D类场地: βgz=0.80×(1+2μf)  其中：μf=1.2248×(Z/10)^(-0.3)
        μz---风压高度变化系数,按《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2001取定,
              根据不同场地类型,按以下公式计算:
              A类场地: μz=1.379×(Z/10)^0.24
              B类场地: μz=(Z/10)^0.32
              C类场地: μz=0.616×(Z/10)^0.44
              D类场地: μz=0.318×(Z/10)^0.60
              本工程属于${REGION}类地区
        μsl---局部风压体型系数,按《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2001(2006年版)取定
        W0---基本风压,按全国基本风压图,${CITYNAME}地区取为${ω0}kN/m^2
(3).地震作用计算:
   qEAk=βE×αmax×GAK
   其中: qEAk---水平地震作用标准值
         βE---动力放大系数,按 5.0 取定
         αmax---水平地震影响系数最大值,按相应设防烈度取定:
              6度(0.05g): αmax=0.04
              7度(0.1g): αmax=0.08
              7度(0.15g): αmax=0.12
              8度(0.2g): αmax=0.16
              8度(0.3g): αmax=0.24
              9度(0.4g): αmax=0.32
              ${CITYNAME}地区设防烈度为${GetAntiEQLevelString(DegOfEq)},根据本地区的情况,取αmax=${GetAmax(DegOfEq,ValOfEq)}
         GAK---幕墙构件的自重(N/m^2)
(4).荷载组合:
   结构设计时，根据构件受力特点，荷载或作用的情况和产生的应力(内力)作用方向，选用最不利的组合，荷载和效应组合设计值按下式采用：
    γGSG+γwψwSw+γEψESE+γTψTST
    各项分别为永久荷载：重力；可变荷载：风荷载、温度变化；偶然荷载：地震
   水平荷载标准值: qk=Wk+0.5×qEAk，维护结构荷载标准值不考虑地震组合
   水平荷载设计值: q=1.4×Wk+0.5×1.3×qEAk
   荷载和作用效应组合的分项系数,按以下规定采用:
   ①对永久荷载采用标准值作为代表值，其分项系数满足：
     a.当其效应对结构不利时：对由可变荷载效应控制的组合，取1.2；对有永久荷载效应控制的组合，取1.35
     b.当其效应对结构有利时：一般情况取1.0；对结构倾覆、滑移或是漂浮验算，取0.9
   ②可变荷载根据设计要求选代表值，其分项系数一般情况取1.4

   df: 玻璃中心的挠度

    E: 玻璃弹性模量

   r1= -2.29 + 5.83×(a/b) - 2.17×(a/b)^2 + 0.2067×(a/b)^3

     = ${GLS_r2}
   df= t×exp(r0+r1×x+r2×x^2)

 \i  Nrksp=ψhsp×Nrkcp     \i0                     (JGJ145-2013 6.1.12-2)
 \i  Nrkcp=Nrkc0×Acn/Acn0×ψsn×ψren×ψecn  \i0  (JGJ145-2013 6.1.3)
   ψhsp: 构件厚度h对劈裂承载力的影响系数,不应大于1.5
   下面分项计算
   hmin:对于膨胀型锚栓和扩底型锚栓，不应小于2hef，且h应大于100mm
 \i  ψhsp=(h/hmin)^(2/3) \i0
 \i       =(${EXABOLT_H}/${EXABOLT_hmin})^(2/3) \i0
 \i       =${EXABOLT_ψhspcal} \i0 取${EXABOLT_ψhsp}
    Ccrsp：混凝土劈裂破坏的临界间矩
 \i   Ccrsp=${EXABOLT_ANCHORTYPE:+2}${EXABOLT_ANCHORTYPE:*3}×hef =${EXABOLT_Ccrsp}mm       \i0    (JGJ145-2013 6.1.11)
 \i   Scrsp=2×Ccrsp=${EXABOLT_Scrsp}mm   \i0       (JGJ145-2013 6.1.12)
 \i   Acn0=Scrsp^2 =${EXABOLT_Acnp0}mm^2 \i0
    Acn=${EXABOLT_Acnp}mm^2
    具体示意图如下(受压锚栓不计入面积)：
    ${EXABOLT_AcnpDrawing}
　\i　ψsn=0.7+0.3×c/Ccrsp \i0
　\i　   =0.7+0.3×${EXABOLT_C}/${EXABOLT_Ccrsp} \i0
　\i　   =${EXABOLT_ψsncpcal}${IsLarge(EXABOLT_ψsncpcal,1):+>1} \i0
　　所以，ψsn取${EXABOLT_ψsncp}。
  \i  ψecn=ψecn1×ψecn2 ≤1 \i0
  \i       =(1/(1+2eNx/Scrsp))×(1/(1+2eNy/Scrsp)) \i0
  \i       =(1/(1+2×${EXABOLT_eNx}/${EXABOLT_Scrsp}))×(1/(1+2×${EXABOLT_eNy}/${EXABOLT_Scrsp})) \i0
  \i       =${EXABOLT_ψecncpcal}${IsLarge(EXABOLT_ψecncpcal,1):+>1} \i0
    所以，ψecn取${EXABOLT_ψecncp}。
　　把上面所得到的各项代入，得：
\i　　Nrkcp=Nrkc0×Acn/Acn0×ψsn×ψren×ψecn \i0
\i　　    =${EXABOLT_Nrkc0}×${EXABOLT_Acnp}/${EXABOLT_Acnp0}×${EXABOLT_ψsncp}×${EXABOLT_ψrencp}×${EXABOLT_ψecncp} \i0
\i　　    =${EXABOLT_Nrkcp}N \i0
\i    Nrksp=ψhsp×Nrkcp \i0
\i         =${EXABOLT_ψhsp}×${EXABOLT_Nrkcp} \i0
\i         =${EXABOLT_Rksp} \i0
\i    Nrdsp=${EXABOLT_HASEARTHQUAKE:+k×}Nrksp/γrsp \i0
\i　　    =${EXABOLT_HASEARTHQUAKE:+${EXABOLT_nk}×}${EXABOLT_Rksp}/${EXABOLT_γrsp} \i0
\i        =${EXABOLT_Rdsp}N    \i0
   由于 γ0×Ngsd=${Mul(EXABOLT_Ngsd,EXABOLT_γ0)}${GetLess(EXABOLT_SPLITPULLLESS)}Nrdsp,所以混凝土劈裂破坏受拉承载力${GetOKStr(EXABOLT_SPLITPULLLESS)}满足设计要求！

  节点模型室外部分长度为：${THERMEX_LENGTHALL}m ${THERMEX_REPLACE:+
  节点模型室外部分总投影长度为\: ${Add(THERMEX_Bf,Add(THERMEX_BpLeft,THERMEX_BpRight))}m 
  节点模型左边/下边板材投影长度为\: ${THERMEX_BpLeft}m
  节点模型右边/上边板材投影长度为\: ${THERMEX_BpRight}m
  节点模型框投影长度为\: ${THERMEX_Bf}m }
  节点模型室内表面温度为${THERMEX_INNERREALTEMP}℃
  节点模型室外表面温度为${THERMEX_OUTERREALTEMP}℃
  室内外温差为${THERMEX_DISPREALTEMP}℃  ${THERMEX_REPLACE:+
  根据《建筑门窗玻璃幕墙热工计算规程》JGJ/T151-2008 7.1.2-1计算替代面板的U值
  1) 左下面板U值计算
  左下替代板材厚度t=${THERMEX_THICKUSERLEFT}m
  板块热阻Rl = tl / λ
            = ${THERMEX_THICKUSERLEFT}/0.03
            = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRLEFT}m^2.K/W 
  替代板块总热阻 ${THERMEX_CONCRADITION:+(考虑替代面板的热辐射)}${THERMEX_CONCRADITION:*
       Rtl = Rl + 1/hc,in + 1/hc,out
          = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRLEFT} + 1/${THERMEX_HIN} + 1/${THERMEX_HOUT}
          = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRTLEFT}m^2.K/W }${THERMEX_CONCRADITION:+
   室外表面换热系数
   hout=hr,out+hc,out     
   式中：
    hout：替代面板外表面的换热系数；
    hr,out：替代面板外表面的辐射换热系数；
    hc,out：替代面板外表面的对流换热系数，按规范取${THERMEX_OUTERAIRCONVECTIONRATIO}W/(m^2·K)；
    hr,out=3.9×εs,out/0.837      (JGJ/T151-2008  10.3.5-3)
   式中：
    εs,out：替代面板外表面半球发射率；取${THERMEX_SURF}
    hout=hr,out+hc,out
    　=3.9×${THERMEX_SURF}/0.837+${THERMEX_OUTERAIRCONVECTIONRATIO}
      =${THERMEX_HOUT}W/(m^2·K)
   室内表面换热系数hin可用下式表达：
   hin = hr,in + hc,in               
   式中：
    hin：替代面板内表面的换热系数；
    hr,in：替代面板内表面的辐射换热系数；
    hc,in：替代面板内表面的对流换热系数，按规范取${THERMEX_INNERAIRCONVECTIONRATIO}W/(m^2·K)；
    hr,in=4.4×εs/0.837      (JGJ/T151-2008  10.3.4-4)
   式中：
    εs = 1/(1/εsurf+1/εs,in-1)    (JGJ/T151-2008  10.3.4-3)
    εs,in：室内环境材料的平均发射率,取${THERMEX_ENVIRMENTINNEREMIT}
    εsurf：替代面板内表面发射率,取${THERMEX_SURF}
    εs = 1/(1/εsurf+1/εs,in-1)
       = 1/(1/${THERMEX_SURF} + 1/${THERMEX_ENVIRMENTINNEREMIT} - 1)
       = ${THERMEX_HRINs}
    对于通常情况下的替代面板表面辐射和自由对流：
    hin=hr,in+hc,in
      =4.4×${THERMEX_HRINs}/0.837+${THERMEX_INNERAIRCONVECTIONRATIO}
      =${THERMEX_HIN}W/(m^2·K) 
    所以有
    Rtl = Rl + 1/hin + 1/hout
       = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRLEFT} + 1/${THERMEX_HIN} + 1/${THERMEX_HOUT}
       = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRTLEFT}m^2.K/W }
  所以左下替代面板的U值
       Upl = 1/Rtl
          = ${THERMEX_BOARDRULEFT}W/(m^2·K)
  2) 右上面板U值计算
  右上替代板材厚度t=${THERMEX_THICKUSERRIGHT}m
  板块热阻Rr = tr / λ
            = ${THERMEX_THICKUSERRIGHT}/0.03
            = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRRIGHT}m^2.K/W 
  替代板块总热阻 ${THERMEX_CONCRADITION:+(考虑替代面板的热辐射)}${THERMEX_CONCRADITION:*
       Rtr = Rr + 1/hc,in + 1/hc,out
          = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRRIGHT} + 1/${THERMEX_HIN} + 1/${THERMEX_HOUT}
          = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRTRIGHT}m^2.K/W }${THERMEX_CONCRADITION:+
   同上计算有
    Rtr = Rr + 1/hin + 1/hout
       = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRRIGHT} + 1/${THERMEX_HIN} + 1/${THERMEX_HOUT}
       = ${THERMEX_BOARDRRTRIGHT}m^2.K/W }
  所以右上替代面板的U值
       Upr = 1/Rtr
          = ${THERMEX_BOARDRURIGHT}W/(m^2·K)
  3) 计算框的U值
       Uf = (L2d,f - Upl×bpl - Upr×bpr))/bf                       (JGJ/T151-2008  7.1.2-2)
  其中
       L2d,f = qw×(bf + bpl + bpr)/(Tn,in - Tn,out)         (JGJ/T151-2008  7.1.2-3)
             = ${THERMEX_HEATFLOWALL}/${THERMEX_DISPREALTEMP}
             = ${THERMEX_HEATREPL}W/(m·K)
       Uf = (${THERMEX_HEATREPL} - ${THERMEX_BOARDRULEFT}×${THERMEX_BpLeft} - ${THERMEX_BOARDRURIGHT}×${THERMEX_BpRight})/${THERMEX_Bf}
          = ${THERMEX_UF}W/(m^2·K)  }${THERMEX_REPLACE:*
  所以该节点模型整体K值为\: ${THERMEX_HEATFLOWALL}/(${THERMEX_LENGTHALL}×${THERMEX_DISPREALTEMP}) =${THERMEX_STRUCTKVALUE}W/(m^2·K) }

         = (${SGPGLS_Efdisp}^3/(${SGPGLS_H1} + 2×${SGPGLS_Tt}×${SGPGLS_Hs2}))^(1/2)  
         = ${SGPGLS_Efstress1}mm
   hefs2 = (hefw^3/(h2 + 2×Ts×hs;1))^(1/2) 
         = (${SGPGLS_Efdisp}^3/(${SGPGLS_H2} + 2×${SGPGLS_Tt}×${SGPGLS_Hs1}))^(1/2)  
         = ${SGPGLS_Efstress2}mm

   玻璃最大应力计算:

      =${SGPGLS_σwo}N/mm^2   
   σwi=6×m×qw×a^2×1000/hefs2^2     
      =6×0.125×${SGPGLS_COMP}×${SGPGLS_awl}^2×1000/${SGPGLS_Efstress2}^2
      =${SGPGLS_σwi}N/mm^2
   ${SGPGLS_STRESSO}N/mm^2${GetLess(IsNLarge(SGPGLS_STRESSO,SGPGLS_fgwo))}ｆg=${SGPGLS_fgwo}N/mm^2

t1: 蜂窝铝板外层铝板厚度: ${ALHCP_T1}mm
   t2: 蜂窝铝板内层铝板厚度: ${ALHCP_T2}mm
   hc: 铝蜂窝芯厚度: ${ALHCP_Hc}mm
   内外铝板材料为${ALHCP_MatOfPanel}
   E: 内外铝板材料弹性模量 ${GetE(ALHCP_MatOfPanel)}N/mm^2
   下面计算蜂窝铝板的等效弯曲刚度De:
   参考《人造板材幕墙工程技术规范》JGJ336-2016 附录A计算
   从上往下各层厚度分别为t1（铝板）,hc（铝蜂窝芯）,t2（铝板）
   y0:蜂窝铝板中性轴的位置
   铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量远远小于铝材弹性模量，计算公式中铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量取0后得到：
   y0 = (E×t2×t2/2+E×t1×(t2+hc+t1/2))/(t1×E+t2×E)                 (JGJ 336-2016  A.0.1-2)
      = (E×${ALHCP_T2}×${ALHCP_T2}/2+E×${ALHCP_T1}×(${ALHCP_T2}+${ALHCP_Hc}+${ALHCP_T1}/2))/(${ALHCP_T1}×E+${ALHCP_T2}×E)
      = ${ALHCP_yo}mm
   De = t1^3×E/12+t2^3×E/12+t1×E×(t2+hc+t1×0.5-y0)^2+t2×E×(yo-t2/2)^2    (JGJ 336-2016  A.0.2-2)
      = ${ALHCP_De}N.mm
   We: 等效截面模量 
   l : 中性轴到铝板面的距离，取${ALHCP_yo}mm
   We = De/(El)                   (JGJ 336-2016  6.5.3-3)
      = ${ALHCP_De}/(E×${ALHCP_yo})
      = ${ALHCP_We}mm^2

${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','1')}: 蜂窝铝板外层铝板厚度: ${ALHCP_T1}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','2')}: 蜂窝铝板内层铝板厚度: ${ALHCP_T2}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','c')}: 铝蜂窝芯厚度: ${ALHCP_Hc}mm
   内外铝板材料为${ALHCP_MatOfPanel}
   E: 内外铝板材料弹性模量 ${GetE(ALHCP_MatOfPanel)}N/mm^2
   下面计算蜂窝铝板的等效弯曲刚度${GetEQSSubFormat('D','','e')}:
   参考《人造板材幕墙工程技术规范》JGJ336-2016 附录A计算
   从上往下各层厚度分别为${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','1')}（铝板）,${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','c')}（铝蜂窝芯）,${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','2')}（铝板）
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','0')}:蜂窝铝板中性轴的位置
   铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量远远小于铝材弹性模量，计算公式中铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量取0后得到：
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','0')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(E×${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}×\\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')},2) + E×${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}×(${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')} + ${GetSSubFormat('h','','c')} + \\f(t1,2)),${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}×E+${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}×E)${GetEQFormat(1)}                 (JGJ 336-2016  A.0.1-2)
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(E×${ALHCP_T2}×\\f(${ALHCP_T2},2) + E×${ALHCP_T1}×(${ALHCP_T2} + ${ALHCP_Hc} + \\f(${ALHCP_T1},2)),${ALHCP_T1}×E + ${ALHCP_T2}×E)${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${ALHCP_yo}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('D','','e')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','3','1')}×E,12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','3','2')}×E,12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}×E×(${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')} + ${GetSSubFormat('h','','c')} + \\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')},2)-${GetSSubFormat('y','','0')})^2${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}×E×(${GetSSubFormat('y','','0')} - \\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')},2))^2 ${GetEQFormat(1)}   
      = ${ALHCP_De}N.mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('W','','e')}: 等效截面模量 
   l : 中性轴到铝板面的距离，取${ALHCP_yo}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('W','','e')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('D','','e')},E×l)${GetEQFormat(1)}                   (JGJ 336-2016  6.5.3-3)
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${ALHCP_De},E×${ALHCP_yo})${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${ALHCP_We}mm^2

校核依据：σ=m×q×lx^2×η/We≤fa            (JGJ 255-2012  6.4.3-3)
   蜂窝铝板的抗拉强度设计值可根据其强度试验平均值除以系数1.428取用  (DGJ08-56-2019 3.2.10)

   m: 玻璃板面跨中弯曲系数,按边长比a/b查表 8.1.5-1得: ${GetSMr(SGPGLS_PS_al,SGPGLS_PS_bl,2,SGPGLS_LINKNUM)}
   η: 折减系数,根据参数θ查表6.1.2-2
