   q=${SGPGLS_COMP}kN/m^2 
   按照《Effective Laminate Thickness for the Design of Laminated Glass》计算各项参数
   hs = 0.5×(h1+h2)+hv = 0.5×(${SGPGLS_H1}+${SGPGLS_H2})+${SGPGLS_Hv}=${SGPGLS_Hs}
   hs;1=hs×h1/(h1+h2)
       =${SGPGLS_Hs}×${SGPGLS_H1}/(${SGPGLS_H1}+${SGPGLS_H2})
       =${SGPGLS_Hs1}
   hs;2=hs×h2/(h1+h2)
       =${SGPGLS_Hs2}
   Is  = h1×hs;2×hs;2 + h2×hs;1×hs;1
       = ${SGPGLS_H1}×${SGPGLS_Hs2}^2 + ${SGPGLS_H2}×${SGPGLS_Hs1}^2
       = ${SGPGLS_Is}
   Ts: 剪力传递系数,系数在0~1之间
   Ts = 1/(1+9.6×E×Is×hv/(G×hs^2×b^2))
      = 1/(1+9.6×${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}×${SGPGLS_Is}×${SGPGLS_Hv}/(${SGPGLS_G}×${SGPGLS_Hs}^2×${SGPGLS_PS_blmm}^2))
      = ${SGPGLS_PS_T} ${IsNEqual(SGPGLS_PS_T,SGPGLS_PS_Tt):+取${SGPGLS_PS_Tt}}
   计算挠度时采用的有效厚度计算如下:  
   hefw = (h1^3 + h2^3 + 12Ts×Is)^(1/3)  
        = (${SGPGLS_H1}^3 + ${SGPGLS_H2}^3 + 12×${SGPGLS_PS_Tt}×${SGPGLS_Is})^(1/3)  
        = ${SGPGLS_PS_Efdisp}mm
   计算单片玻璃的强度时，需要分别给定校核的有效厚度，计算如下
   hefs1 = (hefw^3/(h1 + 2Ts×hs;2))^(1/2) 
         = (${SGPGLS_PS_Efdisp}^3/(${SGPGLS_H1} + 2×${SGPGLS_PS_Tt}×${SGPGLS_Hs2}))^(1/2)  
         = ${SGPGLS_PS_Efstress1}mm
   hefs2 = (hefw^3/(h2 + 2Ts×hs;1))^(1/2) 
         = (${SGPGLS_PS_Efdisp}^3/(${SGPGLS_H2} + 2×${SGPGLS_PS_Tt}×${SGPGLS_Hs1}))^(1/2)  
         = ${SGPGLS_PS_Efstress2}mm     
   参数θ计算:
   θo=qk×b^4×10^9/E/hefs1^4       (JGJ102-2003  8.1.5-4)
    =${SGPGLS_COMPK}×${SGPGLS_PS_bl}^4×10^9/${GetE(GLOB_BOARDMATERIAL)}/${SGPGLS_PS_Efstress1}^4 
    =${SGPGLS_PS_θwo}
   查表6.1.2-2 得ηo = ${GetNg(SGPGLS_PS_θwo)}

     =${SGPGLS_PS_θwi}

   σwo=6×m×q×ηo×b^2×1000/hefs1^2              (JGJ102-2003  8.1.5-1) 
      =6×${SGPGLS_PS_Mr}×${SGPGLS_COMP}×${SGPGLS_PS_Ngo}×${SGPGLS_PS_bl}^2×1000/${SGPGLS_PS_Efstress1}^2
      =${SGPGLS_PS_σwo}N/mm^2   
   σwi=6×m×q×ηi×b^2×1000/hefs2^2   
      =6×${SGPGLS_PS_Mr}×${SGPGLS_COMP}×${SGPGLS_PS_Ngi}×${SGPGLS_PS_bl}^2×1000/${SGPGLS_PS_Efstress2}^2
      =${SGPGLS_PS_σwi}N/mm^2
   ${SGPGLS_PS_STRESSO}N/mm^2${GetLess(IsNLarge(SGPGLS_PS_STRESSO,SGPGLS_PS_fgwo))}ｆg=${SGPGLS_PS_fgwo}N/mm^2 
   ${SGPGLS_PS_STRESSI}N/mm^2${GetLess(IsNLarge(SGPGLS_PS_STRESSI,SGPGLS_PS_fgwi))}ｆg=${SGPGLS_PS_fgwi}N/mm^2

一般情况下幕墙所受负风压大于正风压，下面参考《人造板材幕墙工程技术规范》JGJ336-2016 附录A计算石材蜂窝板的各项特性
   当前石材蜂窝板石材面层材料为${STONEHCP_MatOfFB},面板材料弹性模量 ${STONEHCP_EofFB}N/mm^2
   背板面板材料为${STONEHCP_MatOfBB},背板材料弹性模量 ${STONEHCP_EOfBB}N/mm^2
   ${STONEHCP_IsNetT:+t1\: 石材面板有效厚度\: ${STONEHCP_T1}mm}${STONEHCP_IsNetT:*石材面板公称厚度为${STONEHCP_Tn}mm,粗糙层厚度为${STONEHCP_Tr}mm,净厚度t1为${STONEHCP_T1}mm}
   t2: 与石材面板粘接的背板内面板厚度为 ${STONEHCP_T2}mm
   hc: 铝蜂窝芯厚度为 ${STONEHCP_Hc}mm
   t3: 石材蜂窝板外层背板厚度为 ${STONEHCP_T3}mm
   下面计算石材蜂窝板的等效弯曲刚度De:
   y0:石材蜂窝板中性轴的位置
   铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量远远小于铝材弹性模量，计算公式中铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量取0后得到：
   y0 = [(t3×E3×t3/2+t2×E2×(hc+t3+t2/2)+t1×E1×(hc+t3+t2+t1/2)]/(t1×E1+t2×E2+t3×E3)                 (JGJ 336-2016  A.0.1-2)
      = [(${STONEHCP_T3}×${STONEHCP_E3}×${STONEHCP_T3}/2+${STONEHCP_T2}×${STONEHCP_E2}×(${STONEHCP_Hc}+${STONEHCP_T3}+${STONEHCP_T2}/2)+${STONEHCP_T1}×${STONEHCP_E1}×(${STONEHCP_Hc}+${STONEHCP_T3}+${STONEHCP_T2}+${STONEHCP_T1}/2)]/(${STONEHCP_T1}×${STONEHCP_E1}+${STONEHCP_T2}×${STONEHCP_E2}+${STONEHCP_T3}×${STONEHCP_E3})
      = ${STONEHCP_yo}mm
   y1: 石材面板中线到中性轴距离为${STONEHCP_y1}mm
   y2: 与石材面板粘接的背板内面板中线到中性轴距离为${STONEHCP_y2}mm
   y3: 石材蜂窝板外层背板中线到中性轴距离为${STONEHCP_y3}mm
   De = t1^3×E1/12+E1×t1×y1^2+E2×t2^3/12+E2×t2×y2^2+E3×t3^3/12+E3×t3×y3^2   
      = ${STONEHCP_T1}^3×${STONEHCP_E1}/12+${STONEHCP_E1}×${STONEHCP_T1}×${STONEHCP_y1}^2+${STONEHCP_E2}×${STONEHCP_T2}^3/12+${STONEHCP_E2}×${STONEHCP_T2}×${STONEHCP_y2}^2+${STONEHCP_E3}×${STONEHCP_T3}^3/12+${STONEHCP_E3}×${STONEHCP_T3}×${STONEHCP_y3}^2   
      = ${STONEHCP_De}N.mm
   We: 等效截面模量 
   l : 中性轴到石材面的距离，取${STONEHCP_Te}-${STONEHCP_yo}=${STONEHCP_l}mm
   We = De/(El)                   (JGJ 336-2016  6.5.3-3)
      = ${STONEHCP_De}/(${STONEHCP_EofFB}×${STONEHCP_l})
      = ${STONEHCP_We}mm^2

一般情况下幕墙所受负风压大于正风压，下面参考《人造板材幕墙工程技术规范》JGJ336-2016 附录A计算石材蜂窝板的各项特性
   当前石材蜂窝板石材面层材料为${STONEHCP_MatOfFB},面板材料弹性模量 ${STONEHCP_EofFB}N/mm^2

   ${STONEHCP_IsNetT:+${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','1')}\: 石材面板有效厚度\: ${STONEHCP_T1}mm}${STONEHCP_IsNetT:*石材面板公称厚度为${STONEHCP_Tn}mm,粗糙层厚度为${STONEHCP_Tr}mm,净厚度${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','1')}为${STONEHCP_T1}mm}
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','2')}: 与石材面板粘接的背板内面板厚度为 ${STONEHCP_T2}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','c')}: 铝蜂窝芯厚度为 ${STONEHCP_Hc}mm

   下面计算石材蜂窝板的等效弯曲刚度${GetEQSSubFormat('D','','e')}:

   铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量远远小于铝材弹性模量，计算公式中铝蜂窝芯的弹性模量取0后得到：
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','0')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','','3')}×${GetSSubFormat('E','','3')}×${GetSSubFormat('t','','3')}/2 + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}×${GetSSubFormat('E','','2')}×(${GetSSubFormat('h','','c')} + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','3')} + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}/2) + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}×${GetSSubFormat('E','','1')}×(${GetSSubFormat('h','','c')} + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','3')}+${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')} + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}/2),${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}×${GetSSubFormat('E','','1')} + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}×${GetSSubFormat('E','','2')} + ${GetSSubFormat('t','','3')}×${GetSSubFormat('E','','3')})${GetEQFormat(1)}               
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${STONEHCP_T3}×${STONEHCP_E3}×${STONEHCP_T3}/2+${STONEHCP_T2}×${STONEHCP_E2}×(${STONEHCP_Hc}+${STONEHCP_T3}+${STONEHCP_T2}/2)+${STONEHCP_T1}×${STONEHCP_E1}×(${STONEHCP_Hc}+${STONEHCP_T3}+${STONEHCP_T2}+${STONEHCP_T1}/2),${STONEHCP_T1}×${STONEHCP_E1}+${STONEHCP_T2}×${STONEHCP_E2}+${STONEHCP_T3}×${STONEHCP_E3})${GetEQFormat(1)}

   ${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','3')}: 石材蜂窝板外层背板中线到中性轴距离为${STONEHCP_y3}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('D','','e')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('t','','1')}^3×${GetSSubFormat('E','','1')},12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${GetEQSSubFormat('E','','1')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','1')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','1')}^2 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('E','','2')}×${GetSSubFormat('t','','2')}^3,12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${GetEQSSubFormat('E','','2')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','2')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','2')}^2 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('E','','3')}×${GetSSubFormat('t','','3')}^3,12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${GetEQSSubFormat('E','','3')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('t','','3')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('y','','3')}^2   
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${STONEHCP_T1}^3×${STONEHCP_E1},12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${STONEHCP_E1}×${STONEHCP_T1}×${STONEHCP_y1}^2 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${STONEHCP_E2}×${STONEHCP_T2}^3,12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${STONEHCP_E2}×${STONEHCP_T2}×${STONEHCP_y2}^2 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${STONEHCP_E3}×${STONEHCP_T3}^3,12)${GetEQFormat(1)} + ${STONEHCP_E3}×${STONEHCP_T3}×${STONEHCP_y3}^2   
      = ${STONEHCP_De}N.mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('W','','e')}: 等效截面模量 
   l : 中性轴到石材面的距离，取${STONEHCP_Te}-${STONEHCP_yo}=${STONEHCP_l}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('W','','e')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('D','','e')},El)${GetEQFormat(1)}                   (JGJ 336-2016  6.5.3-3)
      = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${STONEHCP_De},${STONEHCP_EofFB}×${STONEHCP_l})${GetEQFormat(1)}
      = ${STONEHCP_We}mm^2

   c \: 槽口宽度取${GLASSCP_FLCP_C}mm}
   tv: 面板槽口受力一侧的厚度,${GLASSCP_FLCP_GiveTv:+给定厚度${GLASSCP_FLCP_Ttv}mm}${GLASSCP_FLCP_GiveTv:*取tv =(te-c)/2=${GLASSCP_FLCP_Ttv}mm}
   l : 面板跨度,取${GLASSCP_FLCP_bo}m
   h : 槽口受力一侧的深度${GLASSCP_FLCP_h}mm
   β: 应力集中系数，取1.5
   σ = 2×q×l×h×β/(tv^2)
      = 2×${GLASSCP_W}×${GLASSCP_FLCP_bo}×${GLASSCP_FLCP_h}×${GLASSCP_FLCP_Belta}/${GLASSCP_FLCP_tv}^2
      = ${GLASSCP_FLCP_SlotStress}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(GLASSCP_FLCP_SlotBendOK)}${GLASSCP_Fa}N/mm^2  
   面板槽口处产生的弯曲应力${GetOKStr(GLASSCP_FLCP_SlotBendOK)}满足要求

      = ${GLASSCP_FLCP_SlotShear}N/mm^2 ${GetLess(GLASSCP_FLCP_SlotShearOK)}${GLASSCP_Ft}N/mm^2

  抗剪承载力设计值为
  [Vj]= fv×A = ${GetFt(TROEMB_ANSTLEVEL,5)}×${TROEMB_ANSTAREA}=${TROEMB_FVmj}N
  由于
  Nj = ${TROEMB_Nmj}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_AnchorFLESS)} [Nj]=${TROEMB_FNmj}N  锚筋的抗拉承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_AnchorFLESS)}满足设计要求

  = (Nj/[Nj])^2 + (Vj/[Vj])^2
  = (${TROEMB_Nmj}/${TROEMB_FNmj})^2 + (${TROEMB_Vmj}/${TROEMB_FVmj})^2
  = ${TROEMB_AnchorComp} ${GetLess(TROEMB_AnchorCompLESS)} 1
  所以锚筋拉剪复合承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_AnchorCompLESS)}满足设计要求

${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','bt')}: 槽式埋件的螺栓数量
  当前采用的螺栓等级为${TROEMB_BOLTTYPE},直径为${TROEMB_BOLTDIAM}  
  单个螺栓承受的拉力为
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','b')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(\\f(M,d) + N,${GetSSubFormat('N','','bt')})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f((\\f(${TROEMB_M}×1000,${TROEMB_DistOfSup}×2/3) + ${TROEMB_N})×1000,${TROEMB_BOLTNUM})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${TROEMB_Nbolt}N 
  单个螺栓承受的剪力为
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','b')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(V,${GetSSubFormat('N','','bt')})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${TROEMB_V}×1000,${TROEMB_BOLTNUM})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${TROEMB_Vbolt}N 
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','b')}: 单个螺栓的有效截面面积
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','b')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(π×${GetSSubFormat('D','','e')}^2,4)${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(π×${GetDe(TROEMB_BOLTDIAM)}^2,4)${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${TROEMB_BoltArea}mm^2
  单个螺栓的抗拉承载力设计值为
  [${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','b')}]= ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','tb')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','b')} = ${GetFa(TROEMB_BOLTTYPE,TROEMB_BOLTDIAM)}×${TROEMB_BoltArea}=${TROEMB_FNbolt}N
  抗剪承载力设计值为
  [${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','b')}]= ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','vb')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','b')} = ${GetFt(TROEMB_BOLTTYPE,TROEMB_BOLTDIAM)}×${TROEMB_BoltArea}=${TROEMB_FVbolt}N
  由于
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','b')} = ${TROEMB_Nbolt}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_BoltFLESS)} [${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','b')}]=${TROEMB_FNbolt}N  螺栓的抗拉承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_BoltFLESS)}满足设计要求
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','b')} = ${TROEMB_Vbolt}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_BoltVLESS)} [${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','b')}]=${TROEMB_FVbolt}N  螺栓的抗剪承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_BoltVLESS)}满足设计要求
  螺栓拉剪复合承载力校核：
  ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r((${GetSSubFormat('β','','nb')})^2 + (${GetSSubFormat('β','','vb')})^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}              B.0.2-14
  = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r(\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','','b')},[${GetSSubFormat('N','','b')}]))^2 + \\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','b')},[${GetSSubFormat('V','','b')}])))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2
  = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r(\\b(\\f(${TROEMB_Nbolt},${TROEMB_FNbolt}))^2 + \\b(\\f(${TROEMB_Vbolt},${TROEMB_FVbolt})))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2
  = ${TROEMB_BoltCompSqrt} ${GetLess(TROEMB_BoltCompLESS)} 1
  所以螺栓拉剪复合承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_BoltCompLESS)}满足设计要求

Nbt: 槽式埋件的螺栓数量
  当前采用的螺栓等级为${TROEMB_BOLTTYPE},直径为${TROEMB_BOLTDIAM}  
  单个螺栓承受的拉力为
  Nb = (M/d+N)/Nbt
     = (${TROEMB_M}×1000/(${TROEMB_DistOfSup}×2/3)+${TROEMB_N})×1000/${TROEMB_BOLTNUM}
     = ${TROEMB_Nbolt}N 
  单个螺栓承受的剪力为
  Vb = V/Nbt
     = ${TROEMB_V}×1000/${TROEMB_BOLTNUM}
     = ${TROEMB_Vbolt}N 
  Ab: 单个螺栓的有效截面面积
  Ab = π×De^2/4
     = π×${GetDe(TROEMB_BOLTDIAM)}^2/4
     = ${TROEMB_BoltArea}mm^2
  单个螺栓的抗拉承载力设计值为
  [Nb]= ftb×Ab = ${GetFa(TROEMB_BOLTTYPE,TROEMB_BOLTDIAM)}×${TROEMB_BoltArea}=${TROEMB_FNbolt}N
  抗剪承载力设计值为
  [Vb]= fvb×Ab = ${GetFt(TROEMB_BOLTTYPE,TROEMB_BOLTDIAM)}×${TROEMB_BoltArea}=${TROEMB_FVbolt}N
  由于
  Nb = ${TROEMB_Nbolt}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_BoltFLESS)} [Nb]=${TROEMB_FNbolt}N  螺栓的抗拉承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_BoltFLESS)}满足设计要求
  Vb = ${TROEMB_Vbolt}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_BoltVLESS)} [Vb]=${TROEMB_FVbolt}N  螺栓的抗剪承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_BoltVLESS)}满足设计要求
  螺栓拉剪复合承载力校核：
  (βnb)^2 + (βvb)^2              B.0.2-14
  = (Nb/[Nb])^2 + (Vb/[Vb])^2
  = (${TROEMB_Nbolt}/${TROEMB_FNbolt})^2 + (${TROEMB_Vbolt}/${TROEMB_FVbolt})^2
  = ${TROEMB_BoltComp} ${GetLess(TROEMB_BoltCompLESS)} 1
  所以螺栓拉剪复合承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_BoltCompLESS)}满足设计要求

主体结构采用${TROEMB_ConcreteLevel},${TROEMB_DIMDRAWID:+槽式埋件具体尺寸如下图所示\:
  ${XDrawProfileEX(TROEMB_DIMDRAWID,TROEMB_DIMDRAWSLD)}}
  V: 槽式埋件所承受的剪力设计值: 
  V=${TROEMB_V}kN 
  N: 槽式埋件所承受的拉压力设计值: 
  N=${TROEMB_N}kN  
  e: 立柱与转接件连接点到结构上埋板的距离${TROEMB_DistOfV}mm
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('M','','i')}:其他结构传递过来的弯矩${TROEMB_LOADM}kN.m
  M: 槽式埋件承受的弯矩作用
  M= V×e+${GetEQSSubFormat('M','','i')}
   = ${TROEMB_M}kN.m

槽式埋件由${TROEMB_ANSTNUM}个${TROEMB_ANSTLEVEL}${TROEMB_ANDESC}与混凝土结构连接,要保证埋件不被破坏,需要验算${TROEMB_ANDESC}的承载力
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','um')}: 槽式埋件的锚筋数量  
  考虑弯矩作用，埋件的弯矩支撑距离为${TROEMB_DistOfSup}mm,混凝土对底板呈现倒三角的支撑作用，距离弯矩中心越远，支撑反力越大。实际支撑的中心为支撑距离的2/3处。
  单个${TROEMB_ANDESC}承受的拉力为
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','j')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(\\f(M,d) + N,${GetSSubFormat('N','','um')})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f((\\f(${TROEMB_M}×1000,${TROEMB_DistOfSup}×2/3) + ${TROEMB_N})×1000,${TROEMB_ANSTNUM})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${TROEMB_Nmj}N 
  单个${TROEMB_ANDESC}承受的剪力为
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','j')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(V,${GetSSubFormat('N','','um')})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${TROEMB_V}×1000,${TROEMB_ANSTNUM})${GetEQFormat(1)}
     = ${TROEMB_Vmj}N 
  A: 单个锚筋的有效截面面积为${TROEMB_ANSTAREA}mm^2
  单个锚筋的抗拉承载力设计值为
  [${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','j')}]= ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','t')}×A = ${GetFa(TROEMB_ANSTLEVEL,5)}×${TROEMB_ANSTAREA}=${TROEMB_FNmj}N
  抗剪承载力设计值为
  [${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','j')}]= ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','v')}×A = ${GetFt(TROEMB_ANSTLEVEL,5)}×${TROEMB_ANSTAREA}=${TROEMB_FVmj}N
  由于
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','j')} = ${TROEMB_Nmj}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_AnchorFLESS)} [${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','j')}]=${TROEMB_FNmj}N  锚筋的抗拉承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_AnchorFLESS)}满足设计要求
  ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','j')} = ${TROEMB_Vmj}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_AnchorVLESS)} [${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','j')}]=${TROEMB_FVmj}N  锚筋的抗剪承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_AnchorVLESS)}满足设计要求
  锚筋拉剪复合承载力校核：
  ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r((${GetSSubFormat('β','','n')})^2 + (${GetSSubFormat('β','','v')})^2)${GetEQFormat(1)}              B.0.2-14
  = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r(\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','','j')},[${GetSSubFormat('N','','j')}])) + \\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','j')},[${GetSSubFormat('V','','j')}])))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2
  = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r(\\b(\\f(${TROEMB_Nmj},${TROEMB_FNmj}))^2 + \\b(\\f(${TROEMB_Vmj},${TROEMB_FVmj})))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2
  = ${TROEMB_AnchorCompSqrt} ${GetLess(TROEMB_AnchorCompLESS)} 1
  所以锚筋拉剪复合承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_AnchorCompLESS)}满足设计要求

槽式埋件的混凝土锥体抗拉承载力设计值按照下面公式计算
    Nrdca = Nrdca0×αsna×αena×αcna×ψrena×ψucrna    
    上面计算公式中
     Nrdca0 : 单一锚筋的混凝土基本抗拉设计值
     Nrdca0 =4.5×√fcuk×hef^1.5 = 4.5×√${TROEMB_fcuk}×${TROEMB_Hef}^1.5 = ${TROEMB_Nrdca0}N
     αsna : 相邻锚筋间的影响系数
     αena : 混凝土基材边缘影响系数
     αcna : 混凝土基材边角影响系数
     hef: 锚筋的有效锚固深度，取${TROEMB_Hef}mm
   Scrna: 锚筋的临界间距，按照Scrna = 4×hef = ${TROEMB_Scrna}mm取值
     c1 : 槽式埋件与混凝土边缘的距离，对于混凝土两侧的边缘距离，取较小值，本处取${TROEMB_C1}mm
     c2 : 槽式埋件单一锚筋的边角距离，此处取${TROEMB_C2}mm
   Ccrna: 槽式埋件与混凝土边缘的临界距离，按照Ccrna = 2×hef = ${TROEMB_Ccrna}mm取值
     Si : 相邻锚筋间的距离，当前锚筋按照等距布置，锚筋之间的距离为${TROEMB_S}mm
     N0 : 指定锚筋缩承受的拉力荷载
  ψrena: 混凝土基材剥落影响系数,${TROEMB_StirPara:*按照ψrena= 0.5 + hef/200 = 0.5+ ${TROEMB_Hef}/200=${TROEMB_renacal}，且ψrena≤1，}取ψrena=${TROEMB_rena}
 ψucrna: 混凝土裂缝对锚固区预埋件承载力的影响系数，当前为${TROEMB_COPEN:*未}开裂混凝土,取ψucrna=${TROEMB_ucrna}  
   下面对上面需要的各参数进行计算
     αena = (c1/Ccrna)^0.5 = (${TROEMB_C1}/${TROEMB_Ccrna})^0.5 = ${TROEMB_Aenacal} ${IsLarge(TROEMB_Aenacal,1):+取${TROEMB_Aena}}
     αcna = (c2/Ccrna)^0.5 = (${TROEMB_C2}/${TROEMB_Ccrna})^0.5 = ${TROEMB_Acnacal} ${IsLarge(TROEMB_Acnacal,1):+取${TROEMB_Acna}}
     αsna = 1/(1+∑[(1-Si/Scrna)^1.5×Ni/N0]) = ${TROEMB_Asna}   ,说明：该求和计算是将第${TROEMB_AnstInd}个锚筋作为当前锚筋，其他按照临界距离范围内的锚筋来参与求和计算的，Si是临界距离内的其它锚筋到当前锚筋的距离。
   Nrdca = Nrdca0×αsna×αena×αcna×ψrena×ψucrna    
         = ${TROEMB_Nrdca0}×${TROEMB_Asna}×${TROEMB_Aena}×${TROEMB_Acna}×${TROEMB_rena}×${TROEMB_ucrna}     
         = ${TROEMB_Nrdca}N
   由于Nj=${TROEMB_Nmj}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_ConcretePullLESS)} Nrdca = ${TROEMB_Nrdca}N，故混凝土锥体抗拉承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_ConcretePullLESS)}满足设计要求

槽式埋件的混凝土锥体抗拉承载力设计值按照下面公式计算
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','Rd,c,a')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','0','Rd,c,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','s,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','e,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','c,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','re,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucr,N,a')}    
    上面计算公式中
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','0','Rd,c,a')} : 单一锚筋的混凝土基本抗拉设计值
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','0','Rd,c,a')} =4.5×${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r(${GetSSubFormat('f','','cu,k')})${GetEQFormat(1)}×${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','ef')}^1.5 = 4.5×${GetEQFormat(0)}\\r(${TROEMB_fcuk})${GetEQFormat(1)}×${TROEMB_Hef}^1.5 = ${TROEMB_Nrdca0}N
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','s,N,a')} : 相邻锚筋间的影响系数
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','e,N,a')} : 混凝土基材边缘影响系数
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','c,N,a')} : 混凝土基材边角影响系数
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','ef')}: 锚筋的有效锚固深度，取${TROEMB_Hef}mm
 ${GetEQSSubFormat('s','','cr,N,a')}: 锚筋的临界间距，按照${GetEQSSubFormat('s','','cr,N,a')} = 4×${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','ef')} = ${TROEMB_Scrna}mm取值
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('c','','1')} : 槽式埋件与混凝土边缘的距离，对于混凝土两侧的边缘距离，取较小值，本处取${TROEMB_C1}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('c','','2')} : 槽式埋件单一锚筋的边角距离，此处取${TROEMB_C2}mm
 ${GetEQSSubFormat('c','','cr,N,a')}: 槽式埋件与混凝土边缘的临界距离，按照${GetEQSSubFormat('s','','cr,N,a')} = 2×${GetEQSSubFormat('h','','ef')} = ${TROEMB_Ccrna}mm取值
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('s','','i')} : 相邻锚筋间的距离，当前锚筋按照等距布置，锚筋之间的距离为${TROEMB_S}mm
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','0')} : 指定锚筋缩承受的拉力荷载
${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','re,N,a')}: 混凝土基材剥落影响系数,${TROEMB_StirPara:*按照${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','re,N,a')}= 0.5 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('h','','ef')},200)${GetEQFormat(1)} = 0.5+ ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${TROEMB_Hef},200)${GetEQFormat(1)} =${TROEMB_renacal}，且${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','re,N,a')}≤1，}取${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','re,N,a')}=${TROEMB_rena}
${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucr,N,a')}: 混凝土裂缝对锚固区预埋件承载力的影响系数，当前为${TROEMB_COPEN:*未}开裂混凝土,取${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucr,N,a')}=${TROEMB_ucrna}  
  下面对上面需要的各参数进行计算
     ${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','e,N,a')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('c','','1')},${GetSSubFormat('c','','cr,N,a')}))^0.5${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${TROEMB_C1},${TROEMB_Ccrna}))^0.5${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${TROEMB_Aenacal} ${IsLarge(TROEMB_Aenacal,1):+取${TROEMB_Aena}}
     ${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','c,N,a')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('c','','2')},${GetSSubFormat('c','','cr,N,a')}))^0.5${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${TROEMB_C2},${TROEMB_Ccrna}))^0.5${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${TROEMB_Acnacal} ${IsLarge(TROEMB_Acnacal,1):+取${TROEMB_Acna}}
     ${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','s,N,a')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(1,1+∑\\b(\\b(1 - \\f(${GetSSubFormat('s','','i')},${GetSSubFormat('s','','cr,N,a')}))^1.5 × \\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','','i')},${GetSSubFormat('N','','0')})))${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${TROEMB_Asna}   ,说明：该求和计算是将第${TROEMB_AnstInd}个锚筋作为当前锚筋，其他按照临界距离范围内的锚筋来参与求和计算的，${GetEQSSubFormat('s','','i')}是临界距离内的其它锚筋到当前锚筋的距离。
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','Rd,c,a')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','0','Rd,c,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','s,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','e,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','c,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','re,N,a')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','ucr,N,a')} 
         = ${TROEMB_Nrdca0}×${TROEMB_Asna}×${TROEMB_Aena}×${TROEMB_Acna}×${TROEMB_rena}×${TROEMB_ucrna}     
         = ${TROEMB_Nrdca}N
   由于${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','j')}=${TROEMB_Nmj}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_ConcretePullLESS)} ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','','Rd,c,a')} = ${TROEMB_Nrdca}N，故混凝土锥体抗拉承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_ConcretePullLESS)}满足设计要求

槽式埋件的混凝土锥体抗剪承载力设计值按照下面公式计算
    Vrdca = Vrdca0×αsva×αcva×αhva×α90va×ψucrva    
    上面计算公式中
     Vrdca0 : 单一锚筋的混凝土基本抗剪承载力设计值
     Vrdca0 =2.7×√fcuk×c1^1.5 = 2.7×√${TROEMB_fcuk}×${TROEMB_C1}^1.5 = ${TROEMB_Vrdca0}N
     αsva : 相邻锚筋间的影响系数
     αhva : 混凝土基材厚度影响系数
     αcva : 混凝土基材边角影响系数
        ha : 混凝土基材厚度${TROEMB_Ha}mm
     α90va: 剪力与垂直于构件自由边轴线间的夹角对受剪承载力的影响系数，当前为${TROEMB_ForceVParaSide:+剪力与混凝土基材自由边平行且垂直于埋件方向}${TROEMB_ForceVParaSide:*其它情况}，取${TROEMB_alphava}
   Scrva: 锚筋的临界间距，按照Scrva = 4×c1+2×bch = 4×${TROEMB_C1} + 2×${TROEMB_Bch} = ${TROEMB_Scrva}mm
   Ccrva: 锚筋的临界边离，按照Ccrva = 0.5×Scrva = ${TROEMB_Ccrva}mm取值   
 ψucrva: 混凝土裂缝对锚固区预埋件承载力的影响系数，当前为${IsEqual(TROEMB_CrackFactor,0):+混凝土边缘无钢筋或箍筋，}${IsEqual(TROEMB_CrackFactor,1):+混凝土边缘有钢筋且直径≥12mm，}${IsEqual(TROEMB_CrackFactor,2):+混凝土边缘有钢筋和箍筋，且间距小于100mm，}${IsEqual(TROEMB_CrackFactor,3):+非裂缝混凝土，}取ψucrva=${TROEMB_rucrva}  
   下面对上面需要的各参数进行计算
     αcva = (c2/Ccrva)^0.5 = (${TROEMB_C2}/${TROEMB_Ccrva})^0.5 = ${TROEMB_acvacal} ${IsLarge(TROEMB_acvacal,1):+取${TROEMB_acva}}
     Hcrva = 2×c1 + 2×hch = 2×${TROEMB_C1} + 2×${TROEMB_Hch} = ${TROEMB_Hcrva}mm
     αhva = (ha/Hcrva)^0.5 = (${TROEMB_Ha}/${TROEMB_Hcrva})^0.5 = ${TROEMB_ahvacal} ${IsLarge(TROEMB_ahvacal,1):+取${TROEMB_ahva}}
     αsva = 1/(1+∑[(1-Si/Scrva)^1.5×Vi/V0]) = ${TROEMB_asva}   ,说明：该求和计算是将第${TROEMB_AvstInd}个锚筋作为当前锚筋，其他按照临界距离范围内的锚筋来参与求和计算的，Si是临界距离内的其它锚筋到当前锚筋的距离。
   Vrdca = Vrdca0×αsva×αcva×αhva×α90va×ψucrva     
         = ${TROEMB_Vrdca0}×${TROEMB_asva}×${TROEMB_acva}×${TROEMB_ahva}×${TROEMB_alphava}×${TROEMB_rucrva}     
         = ${TROEMB_Vrdca}N
   由于Vj=${TROEMB_Vmj}N ${GetLess(TROEMB_ConcreteShearLESS)} Vrdca = ${TROEMB_Vrdca}N，故混凝土锥体抗剪承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_ConcreteShearLESS)}满足设计要求

混凝土拉剪复合承载力校核：
  (βcn)^2 + (βcv)^2              B.0.2-14
  = (Nj/Nrdca)^2 + (Vj/Vrdca)^2
  = (${TROEMB_Nmj}/${TROEMB_Nrdca})^2 + (${TROEMB_Vmj}/${TROEMB_Vrdca})^2
  = ${TROEMB_ConcreteComp} ${GetLess(TROEMB_ConcreteCompLESS)} 1
  所以混凝土拉剪复合承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_ConcreteCompLESS)}满足设计要求

混凝土拉剪复合承载力校核：
  (${GetEQSSubFormat('β','','N,c')})^2 + (${GetEQSSubFormat('β','','V,c')})^2              B.0.2-14
  = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('N','','j')},${GetSSubFormat('N','','Rd,c,a')}))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','j')},${GetSSubFormat('V','','Rd,c,a')}))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2
  = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${TROEMB_Nmj},${TROEMB_Nrdca}))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2 + ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\b(\\f(${TROEMB_Vmj},${TROEMB_Vrdca}))${GetEQFormat(1)}^2
  = ${TROEMB_ConcreteComp} ${GetLess(TROEMB_ConcreteCompLESS)} 1
  所以混凝土拉剪复合承载力${GetOKStr(TROEMB_ConcreteCompLESS)}满足设计要求

窗扇上每个锁块需要${LOCKPOINT_CountOfBolt}个螺钉,每个螺钉承受的剪力为Vs = Vr/${LOCKPOINT_CountOfBolt}=${Mul(LOCKPOINT_MAXREACTION,1000)}N/${LOCKPOINT_CountOfBolt}=${Mul(LOCKPOINT_MAXBF,1000)}N
   螺钉材质为${LOCKPOINT_MatOfBolt},螺钉直径为${LOCKPOINT_DOfBOLT}mm
   螺钉截面面积为
   As = π×${LOCKPOINT_DOfBOLT}^2/4
      = ${LOCKPOINT_AreaOfBOLT}mm^2
   单个螺钉可以承受的最大剪力为
   Vsmax = τs×As
         = ${GetFt(LOCKPOINT_MatOfBolt,LOCKPOINT_DOfBOLT)}×${LOCKPOINT_AreaOfBOLT}
         = ${LOCKPOINT_Vbolt}N   
   由于Vs=${Mul(LOCKPOINT_MAXBF,1000)}N ${GetLess(LOCKPOINT_BOLTSTRENGTHOK)} Vsmax=${LOCKPOINT_Vbolt}N,所以螺钉抗剪强度${GetOKStr(LOCKPOINT_BOLTSTRENGTHOK)}满足要求

窗扇上每个锁块需要${LOCKPOINT_CountOfBolt}个螺钉,每个螺钉承受的剪力为${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','s')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','r')}/${LOCKPOINT_CountOfBolt}=${Mul(LOCKPOINT_MAXREACTION,1000)}N/${LOCKPOINT_CountOfBolt}=${Mul(LOCKPOINT_MAXBF,1000)}N
   螺钉材质为${LOCKPOINT_MatOfBolt},螺钉直径为${LOCKPOINT_DOfBOLT}mm
   螺钉截面面积为
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','s')} = π×${LOCKPOINT_DOfBOLT}^2/4

   单个螺钉可以承受的最大剪力为
   ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','smax')} = ${GetEQSSubFormat('τ','','s')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('A','','s')}
         = ${GetFt(LOCKPOINT_MatOfBolt,LOCKPOINT_DOfBOLT)}×${LOCKPOINT_AreaOfBOLT}
         = ${LOCKPOINT_Vbolt}N

    2) 门窗边框材质:${MCCON_MatOfFrame}
    3) 与连接片接触面边框壁厚：${MCCON_ThickOfFrame}mm
    4) 连接片和门窗边框连接：卡槽连接；

　             连接片总数量：${MCCON_CountOfFlap}个；
    5) 连接片与建筑结构连接：
　             紧固件类型：${MCCON_MatOfLR}；
　             紧固件公称直径：${MCCON_DOfLR}mm；

1) 整樘结构平米重按照${MCCON_GAK}kN/m^2考虑，
       重力标准值Gk = B×H×GAK = ${MCCON_GK}kN
       重力设计值为G=γG×Gk=${γGf}×Gk=${MCCON_G}kN
    2) 由重力产生的水平地震荷载标准值计算如下
       qEk: 分布水平地震作用标准值(kN/m^2) 
       qEk=βE×αmax×GAK=${βE}×${EqAMax}×${MCCON_GAK} = ${MCCON_qEak}kN/m^2    
    3) 由风荷载和地震荷载产生的水平推力计算      
       风荷载标准值按${MCCON_Wk}kN/m^2考虑 
       风荷载组合系数：ψw = 1.0
       水平荷载组合设计值为
       q = ψw×γw×Wk + ψE×γE×qEk
         = ${γwf}×${MCCON_Wk} + ${ψE}×${γEf}×${MCCON_qEak}
         = ${MCCON_COMP}kN/m^2
       整樘结构所承受的水平剪力为
       V = ${MCCON_COMP}×B×H = ${MCCON_F}kN
     4) 每个连接件承受的剪切荷载
      Vn: 每个连接件所受剪切荷载（N）；
　　  β: 受力不均匀系数，取${MCCON_Belta}；(参见DGJ08-56-2019 11.4.16)
　　   n: 整樘结构中连接片总数；
　　  Vn = βV/n = ${MCCON_Belta}×${MCCON_F}×10^3/${MCCON_CountOfFlap} = ${MCCON_Vn}N

1) 整樘结构平米重按照${MCCON_GAK}kN/m^2考虑
    2) 由重力产生的水平地震荷载标准值计算如下
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('q','','Ek')}: 分布水平地震作用标准值(kN/m^2) 
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('q','','Ek')}=${GetEQSSubFormat('β','','E')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('α','','max')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('G','','Ak')}=${βE}×${EqAMax}×${MCCON_GAK} = ${MCCON_qEak}kN/m^2    
    3) 由风荷载和地震荷载产生的水平推力计算      
       风荷载标准值按${MCCON_Wk}kN/m^2考虑 
       风荷载组合系数：${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','w')} = 1.0
       水平荷载组合设计值为
       q = ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','w')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('γ','','w')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('W','','k')} + ${GetEQSSubFormat('ψ','','E')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('γ','','E')}×${GetEQSSubFormat('q','','Ek')}
         = ${γwf}×${MCCON_Wk} + ${ψE}×${γEf}×${MCCON_qEak}
         = ${MCCON_COMP}kN/m^2
       整樘结构所承受的水平剪力为
       V = ${MCCON_COMP}×B×H = ${MCCON_F}kN
     4) 每个连接件承受的剪切荷载
      ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','n')}: 每个连接件所受剪切荷载（N）；
　　  β: 受力不均匀系数，取${MCCON_Belta}；(参见DGJ08-56-2019 11.4.16)
　　   n: 整樘结构中连接片总数；
　　  ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','n')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}β×\\f(V,n)${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}${MCCON_Belta}×\\f(${MCCON_F}×10^3,${MCCON_CountOfFlap})${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${MCCON_Vn}N

1) 连接片上每个${MCCON_MatOfLR}承受的剪切荷载:
       V1: 连接片上每个${MCCON_MatOfLR}承受的剪切荷载
       Vn: 每个连接件所受剪切荷载
       n : 每个连接片上与建筑结构连接用紧固件数量
       V1 = Vn/n = ${MCCON_Vn}/${MCCON_CountOfLR} = ${MCCON_Vb}N
    2) 连接片与主体连接计算 
       连接采用${MCCON_MatOfLR}固定，按如下公式校核：${MCCON_IsShootNail:+       
       Nvs= 3.7×t×d×f　            6.1.7-7（GB50018-2002）
       式中：
    　　t：被固定的单层钢板的厚度取${MCCON_ThickOfFlap}mm；
    　　d：射钉直径（mm）；
     　 f：被固定钢板的抗拉强度设计值（N/mm2）；
       Nvs= 3.7×t×d×f = 3.7×${MCCON_ThickOfFlap}×${MCCON_DOfLR}×${MCCON_FOfFlap}=${MCCON_Vsnail}N }${MCCON_IsShootNail:*
       Nvb= nv×π×d^2×fvb/4    6.1.4-2(GB50018-2002)
       式中：
         Nvb：螺钉剪切承载力设计值(N)；
          nv：剪切面数：取1；
           d：螺杆直径为${MCCON_DOfLR}mm，全螺纹时取为有效直径取${GetDe(MCCON_DOfLR)}mm；
         fvb：螺钉抗剪强度设计值（N/mm2）；
       Nvb= nv×π×d^2×fvb/4
          = 1×π×${GetDe(MCCON_DOfLR)}^2×${MCCON_FOfExpScrew}/4
          = ${MCCON_Vexpscrew}N }
       由于 V1=${MCCON_Vb}N ${GetLess(MCCON_STRENGTH_FLAPFIXEDSLOT)} ${MCCON_IsShootNail:+Nvs}${MCCON_IsShootNail:*Nvb} ,连接片与建筑结构连接部分${GetOKStr(MCCON_STRENGTH_FLAPFIXEDSLOT)}满足要求

1) 连接片上每个${MCCON_MatOfLR}承受的剪切荷载:
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','1')}: 连接片上每个${MCCON_MatOfLR}承受的剪切荷载
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','n')}: 每个连接件所受剪切荷载
       n : 每个连接片上与建筑结构连接用紧固件数量
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','1')} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${GetSSubFormat('V','','n')},n)${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${GetEQFormat(0)}\\f(${MCCON_Vn},${MCCON_CountOfLR})${GetEQFormat(1)} = ${MCCON_Vb}N
    2) 连接片与主体连接计算

       ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vs')}= 3.7×t×d×f　            6.1.7-7（GB50018-2002）
       式中：
    　　t：被固定的单层钢板的厚度取${MCCON_ThickOfFlap}mm；

       ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vs')}= 3.7×t×d×f = 3.7×${MCCON_ThickOfFlap}×${MCCON_DOfLR}×${MCCON_FOfFlap}=${MCCON_Vsnail}N }${MCCON_IsShootNail:*
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vb')}= ${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('N','','v')}×π×\\b(\\f(d,2))^2×${GetSSubFormat('f','','vb')}${GetEQFormat(1)}    6.1.4-2(GB50018-2002)
       式中：
         ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vb')}：螺钉剪切承载力设计值(N)；
          ${GetEQSSubFormat('n','','v')}：剪切面数：取1；
           d：螺杆直径为${MCCON_DOfLR}mm，全螺纹时取为有效直径取${GetDe(MCCON_DOfLR)}mm；
         ${GetEQSSubFormat('f','','vb')}：螺钉抗剪强度设计值（N/mm2）；
       ${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vb')}= ${GetEQFormat(0)}${GetSSubFormat('n','','v')}×π×\\b(\\f(d,2))^2×${GetSSubFormat('f','','vb')}${GetEQFormat(1)}
          = ${GetEQFormat(0)}1×π×\\b(\\f(${GetDe(MCCON_DOfLR)},2))^2×${MCCON_FOfExpScrew}${GetEQFormat(1)}
          = ${MCCON_Vexpscrew}N }
       由于 ${GetEQSSubFormat('V','','1')}=${MCCON_Vb}N ${GetLess(MCCON_STRENGTH_FLAPFIXEDSLOT)} ${MCCON_IsShootNail:+${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vs')}}${MCCON_IsShootNail:*${GetEQSSubFormat('N','f','vb')}} ,连接片与建筑结构连接部分${GetOKStr(MCCON_STRENGTH_FLAPFIXEDSLOT)}满足要求

    K: 剪应力不均匀系数取${SANDWICHPANEL_K}
    β:剪力分配系数,按下式计算
  \i  β = R1×(D/100)^2 + R2×D/100 + R3×d + R4 \i0

点支承玻璃，往往都是从开孔部位破裂。该部位受力复杂，是一个薄弱环节，应该进行设计计算。设计计算方法可选的有：有限元方法和理论方法。本计算采用理论方法,参考《点支承玻璃幕墙》---龙文志编著。
   按照弹性薄板小挠度理论外缘简支的开孔圆板，在内缘施加均布荷载的力学模型进行设计计算。计算简图如下：
   ${GLSPARSTRESS_DRAWDESC}:
   ${XDrawProfileEX(GLSPARSTRESS_DRAWID,GLSPARSTRESS_DRAWSLD,GLSPARSTRESS_DRAWDESC)}
   W = Lx×Ly×q/n×1/(2πr)
   根据《建筑结构静力计算手册》第二版第199页：
    M = K×W×r
    σ= 6×M/t^2
      = 6×K×W×r/t^2
    代入上式，得到
    σ= 3×K×Lx×Ly×q/(nπt^2) ≤ ｆg

本计算根据《装配式幕墙工程技术规范》T/CECS 745-2020 8.3节编写
 1)硅酮耐侯密封胶的热膨胀位移量按下式计算
   Ut = a×△Ｔ×L                    (T/CECS 745-2020 8.3.1)
   Ut: 受温度变化影响幕墙面板平面位移膨胀量(mm)
    a: 面板材料热膨胀系数
 △Ｔ: 建筑所处环境冬夏最大温差 ${SEALGLUE_TempMax}℃
    L: 面板长度
   Ut = a×△Ｔ×L                    
      = ${Mul(GetAl(SEALGLUE_MATERIALBOARD),100000)}×10^(-5)×${SEALGLUE_TempMax}×${SEALGLUE_BLength}×1000
      = ${SEALGLUE_Ut}mm   ${SEALGLUE_STRUCTRAD:+
 2)风荷载和地震作用下的层间位移按下式计算
    Us = H×θ                   (T/CECS 745-2020 8.3.2)
    H\: 幕墙面板高\: ${SEALGLUE_Hw}m
   θ\: 幕墙层间变位设计变位角1/${GetRecip(SEALGLUE_STRUCTRADT)}
    Us = H×θ 
       = ${SEALGLUE_Hw}×1000×1/${GetRecip(SEALGLUE_STRUCTRADT)}
       = ${SEALGLUE_Us}mm
 3)伸缩接缝宽度计算
    Cn =(Ut + Us)/δ+ k            (T/CECS 745-2020 8.3.3附录)
   δ\: 密封胶的位移能力
    k\: 施工误差
    Cn =(Ut + Us)/δ+ k
       =(${SEALGLUE_Ut}+${SEALGLUE_UsT})/${SEALGLUE_DispCapa}+${SEALGLUE_InstallErrors}
       =${SEALGLUE_Cn}mm
 4)受剪变形接缝宽度计算
    av =(Ut + Us)/[δ(2+δ)]^(1/2) + k
       =(${SEALGLUE_Ut}+${SEALGLUE_UsT})/[${SEALGLUE_DispCapa}×(2+${SEALGLUE_DispCapa})]^(1/2) + ${SEALGLUE_InstallErrors}
       =${SEALGLUE_av}mm
 5)当前选择的胶缝宽度为Cs=${SEALGLUE_GlueWidth}mm
    由于Cn = ${SEALGLUE_Cn}${GetLess(SEALGLUE_CNLESS)}Cs
        av = ${SEALGLUE_av}${GetLess(SEALGLUE_AVLESS)}Cs
    所以硅酮密封胶宽度${GetOKStr(SEALGLUE_CLESS)}满足要求 }${SEALGLUE_STRUCTRAD:*
 2)伸缩接缝宽度计算
    Cn =Ut/δ+ k            (T/CECS 745-2020 8.3.3附录)
   δ\: 密封胶的位移能力
    k\: 施工误差
    Cn =Ut/δ+ k + dE
       =${SEALGLUE_Ut}/${SEALGLUE_DispCapa}+${SEALGLUE_InstallErrors}+${SEALGLUE_DE}
       =${SEALGLUE_Cn}mm
 3)受剪变形接缝宽度计算
    av =Ut/[δ(2+δ)]^(1/2) + k + dE
       =${SEALGLUE_Ut}/[${SEALGLUE_DispCapa}×(2+${SEALGLUE_DispCapa})]^(1/2) + ${SEALGLUE_InstallErrors}+${SEALGLUE_DE}
       =${SEALGLUE_av}mm
 4)当前选择的胶缝宽度为Cs=${SEALGLUE_GlueWidth}mm
    由于Cn = ${SEALGLUE_Cn}${GetLess(SEALGLUE_CNLESS)}Cs
        av = ${SEALGLUE_av}${GetLess(SEALGLUE_AVLESS)}Cs
    所以硅酮密封胶宽度${GetOKStr(SEALGLUE_CLESS)}满足要求 }

单幅幕墙的太阳得热系数SHGCcw应按下式计算
      SHGCcw = (∑gg×Ag + ∑gp×Ap + ∑gf×Af)/A 
          其中gp = αp×Up/(Apse/Ap×he)
              gf = αf×Uf/(Afse/Af×he)
   上式中：
   SHGCcw : 单幅幕墙的太阳得热系数
       gg : 玻璃或透明面板的太阳光总透射比
       Ag : 玻璃或透明面板的面积(m^2)    
       gp : 非透明面板的太阳光总透射比
       Ap : 非透明面板的投影面积(m^2)
       gf : 框的太阳光总透射比
       Af : 框的投影面积(m^2)
        A : 幕墙计算单元的面积(m^2)
       Up : 非透明面板的传热系数[W/(m^2.K)]
       Uf : 框的传热系数[W/(m^2.K)]
       he : 室外表面换热系数，取${SC_He}[W/(m^2.K)]
       αp: 非透明面板的太阳辐射吸收系数，取${SC_AlpheP}[W/(m^2.K)]
       αp: 框的太阳辐射吸收系数，取${SC_AlpheF}[W/(m^2.K)]
      Apse: 非透明面板的外表面面积(m^2)
      Afse: 框的外表面面积(m^2)
    通过计算得到玻璃以及透明面板的各项计算参数如下表:
    ${GetSolarTransmittance_GlassTable(SC_GLSDATA)}
    非透明面板的各项计算参数如下表:
    ${GetSolarTransmittance_FrameTable(SC_PLTDATA,SC_AlpheP,SC_He)}
    框的各项计算参数如下表:
    ${GetSolarTransmittance_FrameTable(SC_FRMDATA,SC_AlpheF,SC_He)}
    通过上面各表格参数计算得到：
    SHGCcw = (∑gg×Ag + ∑gp×Ap + ∑gf×Af)/A 
           = (${SC_GA_Gls} + ${SC_GA_Plate} + ${SC_GA_Frame})/(${SC_AREA_Gls}+${SC_AREA_Plate}+${SC_AREA_Frame})
           = ${SC_SHGCVALUE}
    单幅幕墙的遮阳系数SCcw按下式计算
      SCcw = SHGCcw/0.87
           = ${SC_SHGCVALUE}/0.87
           = ${SC_SCVALUE}

    铝合金门窗水密性能设计指标△P应按下式计算\:
    △P = ${WATERTIGHT_RATIO}×ρ×μz×V0^2                  (6.4.1-1)
    式中\: △P --- 任意高度z处门窗的风压力差值(Pa)；
           ρ --- 空气密度(t/m^3),按现行标准《福建建筑结构风压规程》DBJ/T 13-141的规定查取；
          μz --- 风压高度变化系数，按现行国家标准《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2012的规定进行计算；

   μz\: ${WATERTIGHT_ELEVATION}m高处风压高度变化系数(按${REGION}类区计算)\:   
       μz=${μh}×(z/10)^${α2}=${WATERTIGHT_μzcal} ${IsLess(WATERTIGHT_μzcal,WATERTIGHT_μz):+由于${WATERTIGHT_μzcal}<${WATERTIGHT_μz},取μz=${WATERTIGHT_μz}}

        = ${WATERTIGHT_RATIO}×${WATERTIGHT_MIDU}×${WATERTIGHT_μz}×${WATERTIGHT_WINDSPEED}^2×1000
        = ${WATERTIGHT_DELTAP}Pa } ${WATERTIGHT_METEDATA:*

        μs --- 水密性能风压体型系数取${WATERTIGHT_C}；

  所以有：
   △P ≥ μs×μz×ω0                 (6.4.1-2)
       = ${WATERTIGHT_C}×${WATERTIGHT_μz}×${Mul(1000,ω0)}

(1).场地类别划分:
   根据地面粗糙度,场地可划分为以下类别:
   A类近海面,海岛,海岸,湖岸及沙漠地区;
   B类指田野,乡村,丛林,丘陵以及房屋比较稀疏的乡镇;
   C类指有密集建筑群的城市市区;
   D类指有密集建筑群且房屋较高的城市市区;
   ${PROJECTNAME}按${REGION}类地区计算风压
(2).风荷载计算:
   门窗属于薄壁外围护构件
   风荷载计算公式: Wk=βgz×${GLOB_LC_GD:*K1×K2×}μsl×μz×W0
   其中: Wk---作用在门窗上的风荷载标准值(kN/m^2)
        βgz---瞬时风压的阵风系数
              根据不同场地类型,按以下公式计算:βgz=1+2gI10(z/10)^(-α)
              其中g为峰值因子取为${GLOB_g}，I10为10米高名义湍流度,α为地面粗糙度指数
              A类场地: I10=0.12  ,α=0.12
              B类场地: I10=0.14  ,α=0.15
              C类场地: I10=0.23  ,α=0.22
              D类场地: I10=0.39  ,α=0.30
        μz---风压高度变化系数
              根据不同场地类型,按以下公式计算:
              A类场地: μz=1.284×(Z/10)^0.24
              B类场地: μz=1.000×(Z/10)^0.30
              C类场地: μz=0.544×(Z/10)^0.44
              D类场地: μz=0.262×(Z/10)^0.60
              本工程属于${REGION}类地区
        μsl---局部风压体型系数,按${GLOB_LC_GD:*《建筑结构荷载规范》GB50009-2012}${GLOB_LC_GD:+《建筑结构荷载规范》DBJ/T 15-101-2022}取定
        W0---基本风压,按全国基本风压图,${CITYNAME}地区取为${ω0}kN/m^2
        K1: 地形修正系数
        K2: 风向影响系数
(3).地震作用计算:
   qEAk=βE×Fa×αmaxii×GAK
   其中: qEAk---水平地震作用标准值
         βE---动力放大系数,按 5.0 取定
         αmaxii---水平地震影响系数最大值,按相应设防烈度取定:
              6度(0.05g): αmaxii=0.04
              7度(0.1g): αmaxii=0.08
              7度(0.15g): αmaxii=0.12
              8度(0.2g): αmaxii=0.16
              8度(0.3g): αmaxii=0.24
              9度(0.4g): αmaxii=0.32
              ${CITYNAME}地区设防烈度为${GetAntiEQLevelString(DegOfEq)},根据本地区的情况,取αmax=Fa×αmaxii=${EqAMaxFa}×${EqAMax2}=${EqAMax}
         GAK---门窗构件的自重(N/m^2)
(4).荷载组合:
   结构设计时，根据构件受力特点，荷载或作用的情况和产生的应力(内力)作用方向，选用最不利的组合，荷载和效应组合设计值按下式采用：
    γGSG+γwψwSw+γEψESE+γTψTST
    各项分别为永久荷载：重力；可变荷载：风荷载、温度变化；偶然荷载：地震
   荷载和作用效应组合的分项系数,按以下规定采用:
   ①对永久荷载采用标准值作为代表值，其分项系数满足：

   ②可变荷载根据设计要求选代表值，其分项系数一般情况取${γqf}

 (2)格栅传递的竖向集中力
    格栅承受的竖向线荷载标准值为${GRILLTPOLE_StandLoadOfGL}kN/m，竖向线荷载组合设计值为${GRILLTPOLE_DesignLoadOfGL}kN/m

    qEk = βE×αvmax×Gk    
        = ${βE}×${GetAVmax(DegOfEq,ValOfEq,ConstrSite)}×${GRILLTPOLE_gk} 
        = ${GRILLTPOLE_qEk}kN/m

        = ${GRILLTPOLE_qE}kN/m

    qk = Gk = ${GRILLTPOLE_gk}kN/m
    q  = G + ψE×qE
       = ${GRILLTPOLE_Vg} + ${ψE}×${GRILLTPOLE_qE}
       = ${GRILLTPOLE_q}kN/m
